rows.source_ko: 고용노동부 (혁신행정담당관), 044-202-7056
rows.text_en: Ministry of Employment and Labor ( Innovation Administration Division ), 044-202-7056

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 고용노동부와 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 실장ㆍ국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2010. 7. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies,” such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory bodies within the Ministry of Employment and Labor and its affiliated agencies, as well as the division of duties for auxiliary bodies and equivalent advisory bodies placed under Directors and Bureau Chiefs pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the Government Organization Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended July 12, 2010>

rows.source_ko: 제2장 고용노동부의 과 단위 기구 <개정 2010. 7. 12.>
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Division-level Organizations of the Ministry of Employment and Labor <Amended July 12, 2010>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(대변인) ① 대변인은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보한다. <개정 2013. 12. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Spokesperson) ① The Spokesperson shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service. <Amended Dec. 11, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 대변인의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2023. 7. 27.>
rows.text_en: ② The job grade of the Spokesperson shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Jul. 27, 2023>
③ A Public Relations Officer and a Digital Communication Team Leader shall be placed under the Spokesperson. <Newly established Dec. 11, 2013; Dec. 5, 2018; Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ④ 홍보담당관은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 디지털소통팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <신설 2013. 12. 11., 2018. 12. 5., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Public Relations Officer shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary or Secretary, and the Head of the Digital Communication Team shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Administrative Officer. <Newly added Dec. 11, 2013; Dec. 5, 2018; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 홍보담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 대변인을 보좌한다. <신설 2013. 12. 11., 2023. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Public Relations Officer assists the Spokesperson with respect to the following matters. <Newly added Dec. 11, 2013; Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고용노동정책에 관한 홍보계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of a publicity plan regarding employment and labor policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 장관ㆍ차관 브리핑 및 보도자료 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Support for Minister and Vice Minister briefings and press releases

rows.source_ko: 3. 언론취재 및 보도의 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for media coverage and reporting

rows.source_ko: 4. 언론보도내용의 모니터링ㆍ분석ㆍ관리 및 보고
rows.text_en: 4. Monitoring, analysis, management, and reporting of media reports

rows.source_ko: 5. 언론매체 출연ㆍ인터뷰 및 기고에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning appearances, interviews, and contributions to media outlets

rows.source_ko: 6. 정책발표 사전협의
rows.text_en: 6. Prior consultation on policy announcement

rows.source_ko: 7. 홍보실적 관리ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 7. Management and Evaluation of Public Relations Performance

rows.source_ko: 8. 오보ㆍ왜곡보도에 대한 대응
rows.text_en: 8. Response to False and Distorted Reporting
9. Deleted <December 5, 2018>
10. Deleted <December 5, 2018>

rows.text_en: 14. Inter-departmental Public Relations Consultation

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 디지털소통팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 대변인을 보좌한다. <신설 2018. 12. 5., 2019. 8. 27.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Digital Communication Team assists the Spokesperson with respect to the following matters. <Newly added Dec. 5, 2018; Aug. 27, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 디지털 소통 홍보계획 수립 및 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and operation of digital communication and promotion plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 디지털 채널 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Digital Channel Operation

rows.source_ko: 3. 홍보 콘텐츠 제작ㆍ활용
rows.text_en: 3. Production and Utilization of Promotional Content

rows.source_ko: 4. 실시간 이슈 대응체계 구축
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of a real-time issue response system

rows.text_en: 9. Operation and support of consultative bodies related to employment and labor policy promotion

rows.text_en: 10. Collaborative promotion between departments and bureaus within the ministry

rows.source_ko: 제3조(정책보좌관) 정책보좌관 중 1명은 고위공무원단에 속하는 별정직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. 다만, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 대체하여 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 23., 2018. 9. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Policy Advisor) One of the Policy Advisors shall be appointed as a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. However, if the position is replaced by a general-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 23, 2013; Sep. 5, 2018>

[Wholly Amended Dec. 11, 2013]
[Title Amended Sep. 5, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(기획조정실장) ① 기획조정실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Director of Planning and Coordination Office) ① The Director of Planning and Coordination Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제6조의2제1항에 따라 기획조정실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 정책기획관 및 국제협력관으로 하며, 정책기획관 및 국제협력관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office shall be the Director of Policy Planning and the Director of International Cooperation; the Director of Policy Planning and the Director of International Cooperation shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 정책기획관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제6조의2제3항제1호부터 제4호까지, 제4호의2, 제5호부터 제12호까지, 제20호, 제21호, 제21호의2, 제21호의3 및 제23호부터 제25호까지의 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2020. 12. 29., 2021. 12. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Policy Planning assists the Director General of Planning and Coordination with respect to matters specified in Article 6-2, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 1 through 4 , 4-2, 5 through 12, 20, 21, 21-2, 21-3, and 23 through 25 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly added Dec. 29, 2020; Dec. 14, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ④ 국제협력관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제6조의2제3항제13호부터 제19호까지 및 제22호의 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of International Cooperation assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to matters under Article 6-2, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 13 through 19 and 22 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly added Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 기획조정실장 밑에 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정담당관ㆍ규제개혁법무담당관ㆍ양성평등정책담당관ㆍ비상안전담당관ㆍ국제협력담당관ㆍ외국인력담당관ㆍ지능정보화기획팀장 및 국제개발협력팀장을 둔다. <개정 2013. 9. 23., 2017. 8. 7., 2019. 5. 7., 2020. 12. 29., 2024. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Under the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office, there shall be the Planning and Finance Officer, the Innovation Administration Officer, the Regulatory Reform and Legal Affairs Officer, the Gender Equality Policy Officer, the Emergency Safety Officer, the International Cooperation Officer, the Foreign Workforce Officer, the Intelligent Information Planning Team Leader, and the International Development Cooperation Team Leader. <Amended Sep. 23, 2013; Aug. 7, 2017; May 7, 2019; Dec. 29, 2020; Sep. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정담당관ㆍ규제개혁법무담당관ㆍ양성평등정책담당관ㆍ국제협력담당관 및 외국인력담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 비상안전담당관은 임기제 서기관으로, 지능정보화기획팀장 및 국제개발협력팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2013. 9. 23., 2013. 12. 11., 2017. 8. 7., 2019. 5. 7., 2020. 12. 29., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Director of Planning and Finance, Director of Innovation Administration, Director of Regulatory Reform and Legal Affairs, Director of Gender Equality Policy, Director of International Cooperation, and Director of Foreign Manpower shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, or Senior Secretary; the Director of Emergency Safety shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary on a fixed-term basis; and the Team Leader of Intelligent Information Planning and the Team Leader of International Development Cooperation shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Administrative Officer. <Amended Sep. 23, 2013; Dec. 11, 2013; Aug. 7, 2017; May 7, 2019; Dec. 29, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023; Sep. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 기획재정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2013. 9. 23., 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Director of Planning and Finance assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended Sep. 23, 2013; Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 중장기 고용노동정책의 비전 및 전략 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of Vision and Strategy for Mid-to-Long-Term Employment and Labor Policy

rows.text_en: 2. Formulation, coordination, and integration of various policies and plans

rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the organization and personnel management of public institutions under the Ministry of Employment and Labor

rows.source_ko: 7. 성과계약 등 평가제도의 운영

rows.source_ko: 9. 정책연구개발사업의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 9. Overall management and coordination of policy R&D projects

rows.source_ko: 10. 고용노동백서 발간
rows.text_en: 10. Publication of the Employment and Labor White Paper

rows.source_ko: 11. 업무지식 및 프로세스의 표준화ㆍ관리 및 교육
rows.text_en: 11. Standardization, management, and training of business knowledge and processes

rows.source_ko: 15. 부 내 정부혁신 관련 과제 발굴ㆍ선정, 추진상황 확인ㆍ점검 및 성과관리

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 규제개혁법무담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2019. 12. 2., 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Officer for Regulatory Reform and Legal Affairs assists the Director General of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended Dec. 2, 2019; Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 부내 규제개혁 및 정비업무의 총괄

rows.text_en: 2. Regulatory review of draft laws, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 행정조사 및 부패영향평가 총괄
rows.text_en: 3. Overview of Administrative Investigations and Corruption Impact Assessments

rows.source_ko: 4. 국무회의ㆍ차관회의에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the Cabinet Meeting and the Vice-Ministers' Meeting

rows.source_ko: 5. 입법계획수립 등 입법추진 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of legislative promotion, including the establishment of legislative plans

rows.source_ko: 6. 법령협의 총괄ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management and support of legal consultations

rows.source_ko: 7. 소관 법령ㆍ행정규칙ㆍ법인정관에 대한 심사
rows.text_en: 7. Examination of relevant laws, administrative rules, and articles of incorporation

rows.source_ko: 8. 행정심판 및 행정소송 사무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management of administrative appeals and administrative litigation affairs

rows.source_ko: 9. 법규집의 편찬 및 발간, 법령질의 및 회신의 총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Compilation and publication of statute compilations, and overall management of statute inquiries and responses

rows.source_ko: 10. 국회 법안심사 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning support for the National Assembly's bill review

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 양성평등정책담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2019. 5. 7., 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: 10. The Officer in Charge of Gender Equality Policy assists the Director General of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Newly established May 7, 2019; December 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고용노동 분야 양성평등 관련 정책 및 계획의 수립ㆍ총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, overall management, and coordination of policies and plans related to gender equality in the employment and labor sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 고용노동 분야 성차별적 정책의 모니터링 및 개선에 관한 사항(「남녀고용평등과 일ㆍ가정 양립 지원에 관한 법률」 제2장제1절과 관련한 내용은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the monitoring and improvement of gender-discriminatory policies in the employment and labor sector ( excluding matters related to Chapter 2, Section 1 of the Act on Equal Employment Opportunities for Men and Women and Support for Work-Family Balance )

rows.source_ko: 3. 고용노동 분야 성 주류화(性 主流化) 제도 운영 및 성인지 관점을 반영한 정책 발굴ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of gender mainstreaming systems in the employment and labor sector and identification and support of policies reflecting a gender perspective
4. Deleted <June 10, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 5. 고용노동 분야 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 방지 정책의 수립ㆍ점검 및 예방 교육에 관한 사항(「남녀고용평등과 일ㆍ가정 양립 지원에 관한 법률」 제2장제2절과 관련한 내용은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the establishment and inspection of policies for the prevention of sexual harassment and sexual violence in the employment and labor sector, and preventive education ( excluding matters related to Chapter 2, Section 2 of the Act on Equal Employment Opportunities for Men and Women and Support for Work-Family Balance )

rows.source_ko: 6. 부와 그 소속기관 및 산하단체 내 양성평등 문화 확산 및 성인지 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the dissemination of a gender equality culture and gender sensitivity education within the Ministry, its affiliated agencies, and subordinate organizations

rows.source_ko: 7. 부와 그 소속기관 및 산하단체 내 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 발생에 대한 조치 및 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning measures and prevention regarding the occurrence of sexual harassment and sexual violence within the Ministry, its affiliated agencies, and subordinate organizations

rows.source_ko: 8. 양성평등정책 및 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 관련 대내외 협의에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning gender equality policies and internal and external consultations regarding sexual harassment and sexual violence
9. Deleted <June 10, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 비상안전담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2019. 5. 7., 2020. 12. 29., 2023. 4. 11.>
rows.text_en: 11. The Emergency Safety Officer assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended May 7, 2019; December 29, 2020; April 11, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국가비상사태에 대비한 계획의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, synthesis, and coordination of plans for national emergencies

rows.source_ko: 2. 정부비상훈련
rows.text_en: 2. Government Emergency Drill

rows.source_ko: 3. 직장예비군 및 민방위대의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of Workplace Reserve Forces and Civil Defense Corps

rows.source_ko: 4. 안전관리ㆍ재난상황 및 위기상황 관리기관과의 연계체계 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and operation of a linkage system with safety management, disaster, and crisis management agencies

rows.source_ko: 4의2. 북한 관련 고용노동정책의 총괄
rows.text_en: 4-2. Overview of Employment and Labor Policies Related to North Korea

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 비상안전에 관련되는 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters related to emergency safety

⑫ The Officer for International Cooperation assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended Sep. 23, 2013; May 7, 2019; Mar. 31, 2020; Dec. 29, 2020; Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고용노동분야 국제협력 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정 및 종합계획 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of international cooperation policies in the employment and labor sector, and establishment and implementation of comprehensive plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 고용노동분야와 관련된 통상 및 서비스 등의 협상에 관한 기본계획 및 대응전략의 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of a basic plan and response strategy regarding negotiations on trade and services, etc. related to the employment and labor sector

rows.source_ko: 3. 자유무역협정(FTA) 협상 중 고용노동분야에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the employment and labor sector during Free Trade Agreement (FTA) negotiations

rows.source_ko: 4. 세계무역기구(WTO) 등 다자 간 무역협상 관련 사항 중 고용노동분야에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the employment and labor sector among matters related to multilateral trade negotiations, such as the World Trade Organization (WTO)

rows.source_ko: 5. 민간고용노동외교의 지원 및 조정
rows.text_en: 5. Support and Coordination of Private Sector Employment and Labor Diplomacy

rows.source_ko: 6. 국제노동기구(ILO) 협약비준과 그 밖에 국제노동기구 총회 및 이사회에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Ratification of International Labour Organization (ILO) conventions and other matters concerning the ILO General Assembly and the Governing Body

rows.source_ko: 7. 국제연합(UN), 국제이주기구(IOM) 등 국제기구의 업무 중 고용노동분야에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the employment and labor sector among the functions of international organizations such as the United Nations (UN) and the International Organization for Migration (IOM)

rows.source_ko: 8. 주한 미합중국 군대의 지위협정 중 고용노동분야에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning employment and labor under the Status of Forces Agreement for the United States Forces Korea

rows.source_ko: 9. 국내고용노동상황에 대한 국제사회 홍보
rows.text_en: 9. Promotion of domestic employment and labor conditions to the international community

rows.source_ko: 10. 국제고용노동동향 및 해외노동시장정보의 수집ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 10. Collection and Analysis of International Employment and Labor Trends and Overseas Labor Market Information

rows.source_ko: 11. 고용노동분야 관련 해외주재 공무원에 대한 업무 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Work support for overseas public officials in the employment and labor sector

rows.source_ko: 12. 그 밖에 국제협력관 내 다른 담당관 또는 팀장의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other officers or team leaders within the International Cooperation Office

13. The Officer in Charge of Foreign Manpower assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended Sep. 23, 2013; May 7, 2019; Dec. 2, 2019; Dec. 29, 2020; Dec. 29, 2023; May 20, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 외국인력의 고용 등에 관한 기본정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of basic policies regarding the employment, etc. of foreign workers

rows.source_ko: 2. 외국인근로자의 고용 등에 관한 법령의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 2. Enactment and amendment of laws and regulations concerning the employment, etc. of foreign workers

rows.source_ko: 3. 외국인근로자 도입계획의 수립ㆍ공표ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment, Publication, and Implementation of Plans for the Introduction of Foreign Workers

rows.source_ko: 4. 외국인력 제도 관련 위원회의 운영ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 4. Operation and support of committees related to the foreign workforce system

rows.source_ko: 5. 외국인근로자의 고용 관리 및 취업 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Employment management and job support for foreign workers

rows.source_ko: 6. 불법체류자ㆍ불법고용 대책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and implementation of measures against undocumented immigrants and illegal employment

rows.source_ko: 7. 외국인근로자 고용관리 전산시스템의 활용 및 개선계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment of a plan for the utilization and improvement of the computerized employment management system for foreign workers

rows.source_ko: 8. 외국인근로자 송출국가별 외국인구직자 명부의 운영ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 8. Operation and Management of the Register of Foreign Job Seekers by Country of Sending Foreign Workers

rows.source_ko: 9. 한국어 능력시험 및 기능수준 등의 자격요건 평가계획 수립 및 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment of evaluation plans and guidance/supervision for qualification requirements, such as Korean language proficiency tests and skill levels

rows.source_ko: 10. 외국인근로자 취업교육기관의 지정 및 관리ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 10. Designation and Management/Supervision of Employment Training Institutions for Foreign Workers

rows.source_ko: 11. 외국인근로자 출입국 지원사업의 관리ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 11. Management and Supervision of Support Programs for the Entry and Exit of Foreign Workers

rows.source_ko: 12. 고용허가제 고용업무 대행기관 및 취업교육기관의 지정 및 운영 관리ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 12. Designation, Operation, and Supervision of Employment Permit System Agencies and Employment Training Institutions

rows.source_ko: 13. 외국인노동자지원센터 및 외국인력상담센터 설립ㆍ운영의 관리
rows.text_en: 13. Management of the Establishment and Operation of Foreign Worker Support Centers and Foreign Manpower Counseling Centers

rows.source_ko: 14. 외국인근로자 고용허가제 전용보험 업무
rows.text_en: 14. Operations for the Employment Permit System Insurance for Foreign Workers

rows.source_ko: 15. 외국인근로자 고용 사업장의 지도ㆍ점검
rows.text_en: 15. Guidance and Inspection of Workplaces Employing Foreign Workers

rows.source_ko: 16. 외국인근로자 권익보호협의회의 운영과 외국인근로자의 고충해소 및 권익보호
rows.text_en: 16. Operation of the Foreign Workers' Rights Protection Council and Resolution of Grievances and Protection of Rights of Foreign Workers

rows.source_ko: 17. 귀국대상 외국인근로자의 자진귀국 촉진 및 귀국 외국인근로자의 현지 정착 지원업무
rows.text_en: 17. Promotion of voluntary return of foreign workers eligible for repatriation and support for the local settlement of returned foreign workers

rows.source_ko: 18. 외국인력의 노동시장 연관성 분석ㆍ검토
rows.text_en: 18. Analysis and Review of the Labor Market Relevance of Foreign Workforce

rows.source_ko: 19. 외국인근로자 송출국가의 지정 및 송출국가와의 양해각서(MOU) 체결
rows.text_en: 19. Designation of sending countries for foreign workers and conclusion of Memorandums of Understanding (MOU) with sending countries

rows.source_ko: 20. 외국인근로자 송출국 현지점검 및 한국산업인력공단 외국인력 지원 부서 및 국외분사무소의 관리ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 20. On-site inspections of countries sending foreign workers and management and supervision of the Korea Human Resources Development Service's foreign workforce support departments and overseas branch offices

rows.source_ko: 21. 외국인근로자 도입에 따른 국가 간 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 21. Matters concerning international cooperation regarding the introduction of foreign workers

rows.source_ko: ⑭ 지능정보화기획팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2024. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: 14. The Head of the Intelligent Information Planning Team assists the Head of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended Sep. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 정보화 전략계획 및 시행계획(지능정보사회 실행계획을 포함한다)의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, synthesis, and coordination of informatization strategic plans and implementation plans (including the Intelligent Information Society Implementation Plan)

rows.source_ko: 2. 고용노동부와 그 소속기관, 소관 공공기관의 정보화사업 성과평가 및 성과관리 수준진단에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the performance evaluation of informatization projects and the diagnosis of performance management levels of the Ministry of Employment and Labor, its affiliated agencies, and relevant public institutions

rows.source_ko: 3. 고용노동부와 그 소속기관, 소관 공공기관의 정보화 예산 및 사업의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of informatization budgets and projects of the Ministry of Employment and Labor, its affiliated agencies, and relevant public institutions

rows.source_ko: 4. 고용노동부 홈페이지 및 고용노동행정정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and operation of the Ministry of Employment and Labor website and the Employment and Labor Administration Information System

rows.source_ko: 5. 고용노동부 학습지원시스템의 구축ㆍ운영 및 영상회의시스템 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and operation of the Ministry of Employment and Labor's learning support system and management of the video conferencing system

rows.source_ko: 6. 정보화 자원관리 및 인프라 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 6. Information Resource Management and Infrastructure Construction and Operation

rows.source_ko: 7. 개인정보 보호계획의 수립 등 개인정보 보호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the protection of personal information, such as the establishment of a personal information protection plan

rows.source_ko: 8. 정보보안 및 고용노동부사이버안전센터의 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 8. Information Security and Establishment and Operation of the Ministry of Employment and Labor Cyber ​​Safety Center

rows.source_ko: 9. 고용노동분야의 공공데이터 제공ㆍ이용 및 데이터기반행정 활성화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the provision and use of public data in the employment and labor sector and the promotion of data-based administration

rows.source_ko: 10. 고용노동부 정보시스템의 재난 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning disaster management of the Ministry of Employment and Labor's information systems

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 고용노동행정 정보화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters concerning the informatization of employment and labor administration

rows.source_ko: ⑮ 국제개발협력팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2024. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: 15. The Head of the International Development Cooperation Team assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended Sep. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 개발도상국과의 고용노동분야 국제개발협력[공적개발원조(ODA)사업을 포함한다] 업무에 대한 총괄ㆍ조정ㆍ지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the overall management, coordination, and support of international development cooperation in the employment and labor sectors with developing countries [including Official Development Assistance (ODA) projects]

rows.source_ko: 2. 고용노동분야의 다자 간 국제개발협력에 관한 사항[국제노동기구(ILO) 및 국제연합(UN) 관련 사항은 제외한다]
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning multilateral international development cooperation in the field of employment and labor [excluding matters related to the International Labour Organization (ILO) and the United Nations (UN)]

rows.source_ko: 3. 경제협력개발기구(OECD), 주요20개국(G20)회의, 아시아ㆍ유럽정상회의(ASEM), 동남아시아국가연합(ASEAN)+3, 세계은행(IBRD) 고용노동분야 회의 대응 및 협력사업 추진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the response to and promotion of cooperation projects for employment and labor meetings of the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), G20 meetings, Asia-Europe Meeting (ASEM), ASEAN+3, and the World Bank (IBRD)

rows.source_ko: 4. 아시아ㆍ태평양경제협력체(APEC) 중 고용노동분야 대응, 아시아ㆍ태평양경제협력체(APEC) 인적자원개발 실무그룹회의 및 장관회의 개최에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Responses to the employment and labor sector within the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC), and matters concerning the hosting of the APEC Human Resource Development Working Group Meeting and Ministerial Meeting

rows.source_ko: 5. 「파독 광부ㆍ간호사ㆍ간호조무사에 대한 지원 및 기념사업에 관한 법률」의 개정 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the amendment and operation of the "Act on Support and Commemorative Projects for Korean Miners, Nurses, and Nursing Assistants Dispatched to Germany"

rows.source_ko: 6. 과거 사우디아라비아 진출 근로자에 대한 사회보험료 환불 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning support for the refund of social insurance premiums for former workers in Saudi Arabia

rows.source_ko: 7. 해외진출 기업의 노무관리 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Labor Management Support for Companies Expanding Overseas
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 23, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(감사관) ① 감사관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Auditor) ① The auditor shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service.

rows.source_ko: ② 감사관의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The job grade of the Auditor shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>
③ An Audit Officer and a Civil Complaint Operations Team Leader shall be placed under the Auditor. <Amended Feb. 24, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Dec. 11, 2013; Aug. 24, 2015; Sep. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ④ 감사담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 민원운영팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2013. 12. 11., 2015. 8. 24., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Audit Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary, and the Head of the Civil Complaints Operations Team shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Administrative Officer. <Amended Dec. 11, 2013; Aug. 24, 2015; Aug. 30, 2023; Sep. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 감사담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 감사관을 보좌한다. <개정 2010. 7. 12., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Audit Officer assists the Auditor in the following matters. <Amended Jul. 12, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고용노동부와 그 소속기관, 산하 공공기관에 대한 감사

rows.source_ko: 제6조(고용정책실) ① 고용정책실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2019. 4. 16., 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Employment Policy Office) ① The Head of the Employment Policy Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Apr. 16, 2019; Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제1항에 따라 고용정책실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 노동시장정책관, 고용서비스정책관 및 고용지원정책관으로 하며, 노동시장정책관, 고용서비스정책관 및 고용지원정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director-General for Employment Policy shall be the Director-General for Labor Market Policy, the Director-General for Employment Service Policy, and the Director-General for Employment Support Policy; these directors shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of their positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 노동시장정책관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제3항제1호부터 제8호까지의 사항에 관하여 고용정책실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Labor Market Policy assists the Director General for Employment Policy with respect to matters specified in subparagraphs 1 through 8 of Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly added Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ④ 고용서비스정책관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제3항제9호부터 제11호까지, 제11호의2 및 제12호부터 제17호까지의 사항에 관하여 고용정책실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director General for Employment Service Policy assists the Director General for Employment Policy with respect to matters under Article 10, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 9 through 11 , 11-2, and 12 through 17 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies. ” <Newly added Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 고용지원정책관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제3항제18호부터 제24호까지의 사항에 관하여 고용정책실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2020. 12. 29., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director General for Employment Support Policy assists the Director General for Employment Policy with respect to matters specified in Subparagraphs 18 through 24 of Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly added Dec. 29, 2020; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 고용정책실에 고용정책총괄과ㆍ지역산업고용정책과ㆍ기업일자리지원과ㆍ고용서비스정책과ㆍ고용보험기획과ㆍ고용지원실업급여과ㆍ자산운용팀ㆍ국민취업지원기획팀ㆍ고용서비스기반과ㆍ고용문화개선정책과ㆍ미래고용분석과 및 노동시장조사과를 둔다. <개정 2019. 4. 16., 2020. 12. 29., 2022. 12. 13.>

rows.text_en: 20. Matters concerning relief for damages from workplace sexual harassment and gender discrimination in employment

rows.text_en: 21. Selection and Support of Excellent Companies for Gender Equality in Employment and Work-Family Balance

rows.source_ko: ⑱ 미래고용분석과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2019. 4. 16., 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: 18. The Head of the Future Employment Analysis Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 16, 2019; Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 2. 임금ㆍ근로시간 등 근로실태 관련 통계조사 계획 수립 및 조사ㆍ집계

rows.source_ko: 7. 고용노동통계 모집단 구축

rows.source_ko: 8. 고용노동통계 정보화 및 전산운영

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 고용노동정책 관련 조사의 실시 및 집계
rows.text_en: 9. Implementation and compilation of other surveys related to employment and labor policies

rows.source_ko: 제6조의2(통합고용정책국) ① 통합고용정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 6-2 (Integrated Employment Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Integrated Employment Policy Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조의2제1항에 따라 통합고용정책국장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 청년고용정책관으로 하며, 청년고용정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 10-2, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory body placed under the Director General of the Integrated Employment Policy Bureau shall be the Director General of Youth Employment Policy; the Director General of Youth Employment Policy shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 청년고용정책관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조의2제3항제11호의2 및 제12호부터 제18호까지의 사항에 관하여 통합고용정책국장을 보좌한다. <신설 2020. 12. 29., 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Youth Employment Policy assists the Director General for Integrated Employment Policy with respect to matters under Article 10-2, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 11-2 and 12 through 18 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies . ” <Newly added Dec. 29, 2020; Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ④ 통합고용정책국에 고령사회인력정책과ㆍ장애인고용과ㆍ사회적기업과ㆍ청년고용기획과ㆍ청년취업지원과 및 청년채용기반과를 둔다. <개정 2020. 12. 29., 2025. 10. 1., 2026. 4. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Integrated Employment Policy Bureau shall have the Workforce Policy Division for an Aging Society, the Employment Division for Persons with Disabilities, the Social Enterprise Division, the Youth Employment Planning Division, the Youth Employment Support Division, and the Youth Recruitment Infrastructure Division. <Amended Dec. 29, 2020; Oct. 1, 2025; Apr. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2020. 12. 29., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Each Division Head shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Secretary of Science and Technology, or Secretary. <Amended Dec. 29, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 고령사회인력정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Human Resources Policy Division for an Aging Society shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고령자 고용촉진기본계획의 수립ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and overall management of the Basic Plan for Promoting Employment of the Elderly

rows.text_en: 2. Enactment and amendment of laws and regulations and establishment and coordination of policies related to the prohibition of age discrimination in employment and the promotion of employment for the elderly

rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of support policies for continued employment, such as extending the retirement age and job redesign for older workers

rows.source_ko: 6. 임금피크제 확산 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning support for the expansion of the wage peak system

rows.source_ko: 7. 고령자 전직ㆍ취업 지원 및 직업능력개발 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning support for career transition and employment of the elderly and vocational competency development, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 고령자인재은행 및 중견전문인력 고용지원센터의 지정ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 8. Designation and Operation of Senior Talent Banks and Employment Support Centers for Mid-career Professionals

rows.source_ko: 9. 고령자에게 적합한 사회적 일자리 창출 및 관련 정보망 구축
rows.text_en: 9. Creation of social jobs suitable for the elderly and establishment of related information networks

rows.source_ko: 10. 고용상 연령차별 관행 해소에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the elimination of age discrimination practices in employment

rows.source_ko: 11. 고령자 친화적 고용환경의 조성ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 11. Creation and Support of an Age-Friendly Employment Environment

rows.source_ko: 12. 고령자 고용 우수기업의 선정ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 12. Selection and Support of Excellent Companies for Employing the Elderly

rows.source_ko: 13. 고령자 고용을 촉진하기 위한 세제 등의 지원 정책에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning support policies, such as tax incentives, to promote the employment of older persons

rows.source_ko: 14. 고령자 고용과 관련된 조사, 연구 및 분석에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning surveys, research, and analysis related to the employment of older persons

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 장애인고용과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2019. 8. 27., 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Employment Division for Persons with Disabilities shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Aug. 27, 2019; Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 장애인의 고용촉진 및 고용상 차별금지와 관련된 법령의 제ㆍ개정 및 정책의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Enactment and amendment of laws and regulations and establishment and coordination of policies related to the promotion of employment of persons with disabilities and the prohibition of employment discrimination

rows.source_ko: 2. 장애인 고용촉진과 관련된 위원회의 운영ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 2. Operation and support of committees related to the promotion of employment for persons with disabilities

rows.source_ko: 3. 장애인 고용의무제도의 운영 및 시행 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for the Operation and Implementation of the Mandatory Employment System for Persons with Disabilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 장애인 취업 및 직업능력개발 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Support for Employment and Vocational Skills Development for Persons with Disabilities

rows.source_ko: 5. 장애인 고용환경개선 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Support for Improving the Employment Environment for Persons with Disabilities

rows.source_ko: 6. 장애인 고용촉진 및 직업재활 기금의 운용ㆍ관리(여유자금 운용은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 6. Operation and management of the Fund for the Promotion of Employment and Vocational Rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities (excluding the operation of surplus funds)

rows.source_ko: 7. 장애인 고용장려금 제도의 운영 및 장애인 고용부담금의 징수
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of the Employment Incentive System for Persons with Disabilities and Collection of Employment Levy for Persons with Disabilities

rows.source_ko: 8. 장애인 고용촉진을 위한 사회적 인식 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the improvement of social awareness for the promotion of employment of persons with disabilities

rows.source_ko: 9. 한국장애인고용공단에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 9. Guidance and Supervision of the Korea Employment Agency for Persons with Disabilities
⑧ Deleted <2025. 10. 1.>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 사회적기업과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Social Enterprise Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of a basic plan for the fostering and support of social enterprises

rows.text_en: 2. Enactment and Amendment of Laws Related to the Promotion and Support of Social Enterprises

rows.text_en: 3. Operation of the Social Enterprise Certification System

rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning management support, etc. for social enterprises

rows.text_en: 9. Support for establishing industry- and regional networks among social enterprises

rows.source_ko: 10. 사회적기업에 필요한 전문인력 육성 및 고용지원
rows.text_en: 10. Fostering of specialized personnel and employment support required for social enterprises

rows.source_ko: 11. 사회적기업이 제출한 사업실적 등에 대한 관리
rows.text_en: 11. Management of business performance records, etc. submitted by social enterprises

rows.source_ko: 12. 지방자치단체의 사회적기업 지원시책 수립ㆍ시행 지원
rows.text_en: 12. Support for the establishment and implementation of social enterprise support policies by local governments

rows.text_en: 13. Support for Job Creation Projects by Social Enterprises

rows.source_ko: 14. 한국사회적기업진흥원에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 14. Guidance and Supervision of the Korea Social Enterprise Promotion Agency
10. The Head of the Youth Employment Planning Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021; Jan. 27, 2022; Sep. 20, 2022; Dec. 29, 2023; May 20, 2025; Apr. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 청년고용과 관련된 제도의 운영 및 법령의 제ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 1. Operation of systems related to youth employment and enactment and amendment of laws

rows.source_ko: 2. 고용노동부 소관 청년정책 시행계획의 총괄ㆍ조정 및 추진실적 점검
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of implementation plans for youth policies under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Employment and Labor, and monitoring of implementation performance

rows.source_ko: 3. 고용노동부 소관 청년정책 과제발굴ㆍ관리, 교육 및 소통

rows.source_ko: 5. 고용노동부 소관 청년정책 관련 현안 관리 및 대응
rows.text_en: 5. Management and response to pending issues related to youth policies under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Employment and Labor

rows.source_ko: 6. 청년고용지원과 관련된 사업의 성과관리 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of performance for projects related to youth employment support

rows.source_ko: 7. 청년 대상 고용정책의 온라인ㆍ오프라인 전달체계 기획ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 7. Planning and operation of online and offline delivery systems for youth employment policies

rows.source_ko: 8. 청년 고용동향의 조사 및 분석
rows.text_en: 8. Survey and Analysis of Youth Employment Trends

rows.source_ko: 9. 공공기관 청년고용의무제 관리ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Management and overall oversight of the Public Institution Youth Employment Mandate System

rows.source_ko: 10. 청년고용지원 정책에 관한 홍보의 기획ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 10. Planning and overall management of publicity regarding youth employment support policies

rows.source_ko: 11. 한국잡월드 등 직업체험센터의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 11. Guidance and supervision of vocational experience centers such as Korea Job World

rows.source_ko: 12. 청년 관련 비영리법인의 허가 및 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 12. Permission, Guidance, and Supervision of Youth-Related Non-Profit Corporations

rows.source_ko: 13. 대학의 취업ㆍ직업진로지도 활성화 사업의 지원
rows.text_en: 13. Support for projects to revitalize employment and career guidance at universities

rows.source_ko: 13의2. 「청년기본법 시행령」 제21조의2제1항제4호에 따른 청년 관련 정책자문기구의 운영 지원

rows.source_ko: 13의3. 직업진로지도 및 직업정보제공 등의 개발ㆍ확산 및 홍보ㆍ교육
rows.text_en: 13-3. Development, dissemination, promotion, and education of vocational career guidance and provision of vocational information

rows.source_ko: 13의4. 청년고용을 촉진할 수 있는 새로운 직업의 발굴을 위한 정책의 수립 및 시행

rows.source_ko: 제7조(노동정책실) ① 노동정책실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 1. 30., 2020. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Labor Policy Office) ① The Director of the Labor Policy Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Jan. 30, 2015; Dec. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제11조제1항에 따라 노동정책실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 노동정책관, 노사협력정책관, 근로기준정책관 및 근로감독정책단장으로 하며, 노동정책관, 노사협력정책관, 근로기준정책관 및 근로감독정책단장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2020. 12. 29., 2023. 4. 11., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director-General for Labor Policy shall be the Director-General for Labor Policy, the Director-General for Labor-Management Cooperation Policy, the Director-General for Labor Standards Policy, and the Head of the Labor Inspection Policy Group; the Director-General for Labor Policy, the Director-General for Labor-Management Cooperation Policy, the Director-General for Labor Standards Policy, and the Head of the Labor Inspection Policy Group shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 29, 2020; Apr. 11, 2023; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 노동정책관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제11조제3항제1호ㆍ제4호ㆍ제23호ㆍ제26호ㆍ제28호 및 제31호의 사항에 관하여 노동정책실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2023. 4. 11., 2024. 6. 10., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Labor Policy assists the Director General for Labor Policy with respect to matters under Article 11 , Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 1 , 4, 23, 26, 28, and 31 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Amended Apr. 11, 2023; Jun. 10, 2024; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 노사협력정책관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제11조제3항제2호, 제3호, 제5호부터 제13호까지, 제29호 및 제30호의 사항에 관하여 노동정책실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2023. 4. 11.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director General for Labor-Management Cooperation Policy assists the Director General for Labor Policy with respect to matters under Article 11 , Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 2 , 3 , 5 through 13, 29, and 30 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Amended Apr. 11, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 근로기준정책관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제11조제3항제14호부터 제16호까지, 제19호부터 제22호까지, 제24호ㆍ제25호 및 제27호의 사항에 관하여 노동정책실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2023. 4. 11., 2024. 6. 10., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director General for Labor Standards Policy assists the Director General for Labor Policy with respect to matters under Article 11, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 14 through 16 , 19 through 22, 24, 25, and 27 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Amended Apr. 11, 2023; Jun. 10, 2024; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 근로감독정책단장은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제11조제3항제16호의2ㆍ제16호의3 및 제32호의 사항에 관하여 노동정책실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Director of the Labor Inspection Policy Division assists the Director General of Labor Policy with respect to matters under Article 11, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 16-2 , 16-3, and 32 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and Its Affiliated Agencies .” <Newly added Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 노동정책실에 노동정책총괄과ㆍ노무제공자지원과ㆍ공공노사관계과ㆍ노사협력정책과ㆍ노사관계법제과ㆍ노사관계지원과ㆍ근로기준정책과ㆍ퇴직연금복지과ㆍ고용차별개선과ㆍ근로감독기획과 및 근로감독협력과를 둔다. <개정 2023. 4. 11., 2024. 6. 10., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Labor Policy Office shall have the Labor Policy Coordination Division, Service Provider Support Division, Public Sector Labor-Management Relations Division, Labor-Management Cooperation Policy Division, Labor-Management Relations Legislation Division, Labor-Management Relations Support Division, Labor Standards Policy Division, Retirement Pension and Welfare Division, Employment Discrimination Improvement Division, Labor Inspection Planning Division, and Labor Inspection Cooperation Division. <Amended Apr. 11, 2023; Jun. 10, 2024; Oct. 1, 2025>
⑧ Each Division Head shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Secretary of Science and Technology, or Secretary. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Dec. 29, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 노무제공자지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2024. 6. 10., 2025. 10. 1.>

rows.source_ko: 1. 노무제공자(「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제11조제3항제26호에 따른 노무제공자를 말한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)의 권익 보호 정책 수립 및 법ㆍ제도 개선

Establishment of policies for the protection of the rights and interests of service providers ( referring to service providers pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraph 26 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and its Affiliated Agencies” ; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph) and improvement of laws and systems

rows.text_en: 11. The Head of the Public Sector Labor Relations Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 11, 2023; Oct. 1, 2025>
