rows.source_ko: 제8조(산업안전보건정책실) ① 산업안전보건정책실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하고, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Industrial Safety and Health Policy Office) ① The Head of the Industrial Safety and Health Policy Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제1항에 따라 산업안전보건정책실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 산업안전예방정책관 및 산업보건보상정책관으로 하며, 산업안전예방정책관 및 산업보건보상정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하고, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the Industrial Safety and Health Policy Office shall be the Director of Industrial Safety Prevention Policy and the Director of Industrial Health Compensation Policy; the Director of Industrial Safety Prevention Policy and the Director of Industrial Health Compensation Policy shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the positions shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 산업안전예방정책관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제3항제1호부터 제6호까지 중 산업안전에 관한 사항 및 제7호부터 제10호까지의 사항에 관하여 산업안전보건정책실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Industrial Safety and Health Policy assists the Director of the Industrial Safety and Health Policy Office with respect to matters concerning industrial safety among subparagraphs 1 through 6 of Article 13 , Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and its Affiliated Agencies” and matters from subparagraphs 7 through 10.

rows.source_ko: ④ 산업보건보상정책관은 「고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제3항제1호부터 제6호까지 중 산업보건에 관한 사항 및 제11호부터 제18호까지의 사항에 관하여 산업안전보건정책실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of Industrial Health Compensation Policy assists the Director of the Industrial Safety and Health Policy Office with respect to matters concerning industrial health among subparagraphs 1 through 6 of Article 13, Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and its Affiliated Agencies” and matters from subparagraphs 11 through 18.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 산업안전보건정책실에 산업안전정책과ㆍ산업안전기준과ㆍ산재예방지원과ㆍ산업보건정책과ㆍ산재보상정책과ㆍ노무제공자안전보호과ㆍ직업건강증진팀을 둔다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Industrial Safety and Health Policy Office shall have the Industrial Safety Policy Division, Industrial Safety Standards Division, Industrial Accident Prevention Support Division, Industrial Health Policy Division, Industrial Accident Compensation Policy Division, Labor Provider Safety Protection Division, and Occupational Health Promotion Team.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ Each division head shall be appointed as a deputy director, science and technology secretary, or secretary, and each team leader shall be appointed as a science and technology secretary, secretary, industrial officer, health officer, facilities officer, or administrative officer.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 산업안전정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Industrial Safety Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업안전정책 수립ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and overall management of industrial safety policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 산업안전제도의 개선을 위한 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research and investigation for the improvement of the industrial safety system

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업안전보건법령 및 기준의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 3. Enactment and Amendment of Industrial Safety and Health Acts and Standards

rows.source_ko: 4. 산업안전을 위한 기술의 연구개발 및 시설의 설치ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 4. Research and development of technology for industrial safety and installation and operation of facilities

rows.source_ko: 5. 산업재해 관련 통계의 분석 및 유지ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 5. Analysis and Maintenance of Industrial Accident Statistics

rows.source_ko: 6. 사업장의 산업재해 발생건수 등의 공표에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the publication of the number of industrial accidents, etc. at workplaces

rows.source_ko: 7. 산업안전보건투자계획의 수립 및 효과분석
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment of Industrial Safety and Health Investment Plan and Effect Analysis

rows.source_ko: 8. 산재예방 정보화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the informatization of industrial accident prevention

rows.source_ko: 9. 한국산업안전보건공단의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 9. Guidance and supervision by the Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency

rows.source_ko: 10. 산재예방요율제에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the industrial accident prevention rate system

rows.source_ko: 11. 산업안전 관련 국제협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning international cooperation related to industrial safety

rows.source_ko: 12. 지방자치단체 및 유관기관과의 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning cooperation with local governments and related organizations

rows.source_ko: 13. 작업환경 실태조사 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning surveys on working conditions, etc.

rows.source_ko: 14. 산업안전지도사 및 산업보건지도사 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the Industrial Safety Instructor and Industrial Health Instructor systems

rows.source_ko: 15. 공공기관의 안전 활동 수준평가와 안전 확보를 위한 지원ㆍ협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning the assessment of safety activity levels in public institutions and support and cooperation for ensuring safety

rows.source_ko: 16. 그 밖에 산업안전에 관한 사항으로서 다른 부서의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Other matters concerning industrial safety that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other departments

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 산업안전기준과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Industrial Safety Standards Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업안전정책의 수립ㆍ시행(건설업에 관한 사항은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of industrial safety policies (excluding matters concerning the construction industry)

rows.source_ko: 2. 산업안전기준에 관한 사항(건설업에 관한 사항은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning industrial safety standards (excluding matters concerning the construction industry)

rows.source_ko: 3. 도급사업의 안전보건조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning safety and health measures for contracted projects

rows.source_ko: 4. 안전인증, 자율안전확인, 안전검사 및 자율검사프로그램 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning safety certification, voluntary safety confirmation, safety inspection, and voluntary inspection program systems

rows.source_ko: 5. 유해ㆍ위험방지계획서 제도에 관한 사항(건설업에 관한 사항은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the hazardous and dangerous prevention plan system (excluding matters concerning the construction industry)

rows.source_ko: 6. 유해ㆍ위험한 기계ㆍ기구 등의 방호조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning protective measures for hazardous or dangerous machinery, equipment, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 사업장에 대한 안전 분야 기술지도 및 재정지원(건설업에 관한 사항은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 7. Technical guidance and financial support in the safety field for workplaces (excluding matters concerning the construction industry)

rows.source_ko: 8. 안전관리자 및 안전관리전문기관 제도에 관한 사항(건설업에 관한 사항은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the safety manager and specialized safety management agency system (excluding matters concerning the construction industry)

rows.source_ko: 9. 유해ㆍ위험작업 취업제한제도 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of the Employment Restriction System for Hazardous and Dangerous Work

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 산업안전기준에 관한 사항(건설업에 관한 사항은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters concerning industrial safety standards (excluding matters concerning the construction industry)

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 산재예방지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Industrial Accident Prevention Support Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업재해 예방 및 지원계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of industrial accident prevention and support plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 안전ㆍ보건 관리체제의 총괄에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the overall management of the safety and health management system

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업장 안전ㆍ보건 경영체제에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the workplace safety and health management system

rows.source_ko: 4. 산업안전보건 홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning industrial safety and health promotion

rows.source_ko: 5. 산재예방유공자 포상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning awards for persons of merit in industrial accident prevention

rows.source_ko: 6. 안전의식 및 안전문화 진흥에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the promotion of safety awareness and safety culture

rows.source_ko: 7. 안전보건관리규정 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the safety and health management regulations system

rows.source_ko: 8. 산업안전보건 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning industrial safety and health education

rows.source_ko: 9. 위험성평가 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the risk assessment system

rows.source_ko: 10. 지방자치단체의 산업재해 예방활동 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Support for local governments' industrial accident prevention activities

rows.source_ko: 11. 중대재해 발생원인 분석 및 대책수립
rows.text_en: 11. Analysis of Causes of Serious Accidents and Establishment of Countermeasures

rows.source_ko: 12. 「중대재해처벌 등에 관한 법률」에 따른 안전보건관리체계 구축 지원
rows.text_en: 12. Support for establishing a safety and health management system pursuant to the Act on the Punishment, etc. of Serious Accidents

rows.source_ko: 13. 그 밖에 산업재해 예방 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Other matters concerning support for industrial accident prevention

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 산업보건정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Industrial Health Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업보건정책의 수립ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and overall management of industrial health policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 산업보건기준에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning industrial health standards

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업보건제도의 개선을 위한 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 3. Surveys and Research for the Improvement of the Industrial Health System

rows.source_ko: 4. 산업보건을 위한 기술의 연구개발 및 시설의 설치ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 4. Research and development of technology for industrial health and installation and operation of facilities

rows.source_ko: 5. 산업보건 관련 국제협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning international cooperation related to industrial health

rows.source_ko: 6. 직업병 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the prevention of occupational diseases

rows.source_ko: 7. 보건관리자, 산업보건의 및 보건관리전문기관 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the systems for health managers, occupational health physicians, and specialized health management agencies

rows.source_ko: 8. 작업환경측정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning workplace environment measurement

rows.source_ko: 9. 유해인자의 노출기준 및 허용기준에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning exposure limits and permissible limits for hazardous agents

rows.source_ko: 10. 유해인자의 분류 및 관리 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the classification and management of hazardous substances, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 유해ㆍ위험 물질의 제조ㆍ수입 등의 금지 및 허가제도 운영
rows.text_en: 11. Prohibition of Manufacture, Import, etc., of Hazardous and Dangerous Substances and Operation of the Licensing System

rows.source_ko: 12. 석면관리 및 석면으로 인한 질환 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning asbestos management and prevention of asbestos-induced diseases

rows.source_ko: 13. 밀폐공간작업의 안전보건조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning safety and health measures for confined space work

rows.source_ko: 14. 근로자 건강진단 및 건강관리카드 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the worker health examination and health management card system

rows.source_ko: 15. 직업성 질환의 역학조사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning the epidemiological investigation of occupational diseases

rows.source_ko: 16. 물리적(고열ㆍ한랭 제외)ㆍ생물학적 인자 등으로 인한 건강장해 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Matters concerning the prevention of health hazards caused by physical (excluding high heat and cold) and biological factors, etc.

rows.source_ko: 17. 사무실에서의 건강장해 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Matters concerning the prevention of health hazards in the office

rows.source_ko: 18. 근로자의 뇌심혈관계질환 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Matters concerning the prevention of cerebrovascular and cardiovascular diseases in workers

rows.source_ko: 19. 그 밖에 산업보건에 관한 사항으로서 다른 부서의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 19. Other matters concerning industrial health that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other departments

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 산재보상정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑪ The Head of the Industrial Accident Compensation Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업재해보상보험과 관련된 법령의 제정ㆍ개정 및 정책의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Enactment and amendment of laws and regulations and establishment of policies related to industrial accident compensation insurance

rows.source_ko: 2. 산업재해보상보험과 관련된 위원회의 운영ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 2. Operation and support of committees related to industrial accident compensation insurance

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업재해근로자의 요양, 보상 및 직업재활제도 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of the Medical Treatment, Compensation, and Vocational Rehabilitation System for Workers with Industrial Accidents

rows.source_ko: 4. 진폐의 예방과 진폐근로자의 보호 등에 관한 법령 제정ㆍ개정 및 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Enactment, Amendment, and Operation of Laws and Regulations Concerning the Prevention of Pneumoconiosis and the Protection of Workers with Pneumoconiosis

rows.source_ko: 5. 산업재해근로자 복지제도 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Operation of the Welfare System for Workers with Industrial Accidents

rows.source_ko: 6. 산업보험 의료기관 평가제도 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of the Industrial Insurance Medical Institution Evaluation System

rows.source_ko: 7. 산업재해보상보험과 관련된 전산망의 운영ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 7. Operation and management of computer networks related to industrial accident compensation insurance

rows.source_ko: 8. 산업재해보상보험과 관련된 통계 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Management of statistics related to industrial accident compensation insurance

rows.source_ko: 9. 산업재해보상보험과 관련된 외국제도의 분석 및 국제협력
rows.text_en: 9. Analysis of Foreign Systems Related to Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance and International Cooperation

rows.source_ko: 10. 산업재해보상보험 심사 및 재심사제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Operation of the Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance Review and Re-review System

rows.source_ko: 11. 산업재해보상보험및예방기금 및 재산의 운용ㆍ관리(여유자금 운용에 관한 사항은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 11. Operation and management of the Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance and Prevention Fund and its assets (excluding matters concerning the operation of surplus funds)

rows.source_ko: 12. 산업재해보상보험의 보험료율에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the premium rates for industrial accident compensation insurance

rows.source_ko: 13. 근로복지공단의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 13. Guidance and Supervision by the Korea Workers' Welfare Service

rows.source_ko: 14. 산업재해보상보험시설의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 14. Guidance and Supervision of Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance Facilities

rows.source_ko: 15. 「산업재해보상보험법」 제111조의2에 따른 보험급여 신청을 이유로 한 불이익 처우의 금지를 위한 제도의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 15. Establishment and implementation of a system to prohibit disadvantageous treatment based on an application for insurance benefits pursuant to Article 111-2 of the Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance Act

rows.source_ko: 16. 산업재해보상보험 보험료의 부과ㆍ징수 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Matters concerning the imposition and collection, etc. of industrial accident compensation insurance premiums

rows.source_ko: 17. 산업재해보상보험 사무대행기관의 관리
rows.text_en: 17. Management of Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance Administrative Agencies

rows.source_ko: 18. 근로복지공단의 산업재해보상보험 보험료 징수 업무 등에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 18. Guidance and supervision of the Korea Workers' Welfare Service's industrial accident compensation insurance premium collection duties, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 노무제공자안전보호과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑫ The Head of the Labor Provider Safety Protection Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 노무제공자 산업안전보건정책 수립ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and overall management of industrial safety and health policies for service providers

rows.source_ko: 2. 노무제공자 작업환경 조사 및 산업안전보건제도의 개선을 위한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Investigation of Working Environments of Service Providers and Improvement of the Industrial Safety and Health System

rows.source_ko: 3. 노무제공자 산업안전보건법령 및 안전보건기준의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 3. Enactment and Amendment of Occupational Safety and Health Acts and Safety and Health Standards for Service Providers

rows.source_ko: 4. 노무제공자 산업안전기준 준수 여부 지도
rows.text_en: 4. Guidance on Service Providers' Compliance with Industrial Safety Standards

rows.source_ko: 5. 노무제공자 산업재해 예방 지원계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and implementation of support plans for industrial accident prevention by service providers

rows.source_ko: 6. 노무제공자 산업안전보건 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning industrial safety and health education for service providers

rows.source_ko: 7. 노무제공자 산업안전보건 홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the promotion of industrial safety and health by service providers

rows.source_ko: 8. 노무제공자 산업재해 예방 지원 정책 관련 관계부처 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8. Consultation and coordination with relevant ministries regarding support policies for industrial accident prevention of service providers

rows.source_ko: 9. 노무제공자의 건강장해 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the prevention of health hazards for service providers

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 노무제공자 산업재해 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters concerning the prevention of industrial accidents by service providers

rows.source_ko: ⑬ 직업건강증진팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑬ The Occupational Health Promotion Team Leader is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 건강증진정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Implementation of Health Promotion Policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 건강증진 기준에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning health promotion standards

rows.source_ko: 3. 근골격계질환 등 작업 관련성 질환 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the prevention of work-related diseases, such as musculoskeletal disorders

rows.source_ko: 4. 사업장에 대한 보건 분야 기술지도
rows.text_en: 4. Technical guidance in the health sector for workplaces

rows.source_ko: 5. 사업장 건강증진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning workplace health promotion

rows.source_ko: 6. 폭염ㆍ한파ㆍ미세먼지 등 환경적 요인에 의한 건강장해 예방
rows.text_en: 6. Prevention of health hazards caused by environmental factors such as heatwaves, cold waves, and fine dust

rows.source_ko: 7. 고열ㆍ한랭에 의한 건강장해 예방
rows.text_en: 7. Prevention of health hazards caused by high fever and cold

rows.source_ko: 8. 직무 스트레스, 고객 등의 폭언 등으로 인한 정신건강 장해 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the prevention of mental health disorders caused by job stress, verbal abuse from customers, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 건강의 유지ㆍ증진을 위한 시설 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the operation of facilities for the maintenance and promotion of health

rows.source_ko: 10. 휴게시설, 세면ㆍ목욕시설 등 위생시설에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning sanitary facilities, such as rest areas and washbasin/bath facilities

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 근로자 건강보호 및 증진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters concerning the protection and promotion of workers' health
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(안전보건감독국) ① 안전보건감독국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Safety and Health Supervision Bureau) ① The Director of the Safety and Health Supervision Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 안전보건감독국에 안전보건감독기획과ㆍ중대산업재해수사과ㆍ건설산재예방감독과 및 화학사고예방조사과를 둔다.
rows.text_en: ② The Safety and Health Supervision Bureau shall have the Safety and Health Supervision Planning Division, the Serious Industrial Accident Investigation Division, the Construction Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Division, and the Chemical Accident Prevention Investigation Division.

rows.source_ko: ③ 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Each section chief shall be appointed as a deputy director, science and technology secretary, or secretary.

rows.source_ko: ④ 안전보건감독기획과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Safety and Health Supervision Planning Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업장 안전ㆍ보건 감독과 관련된 정책의 수립 및 제도개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the establishment of policies and institutional improvements related to workplace safety and health supervision

rows.source_ko: 2. 사업장 안전ㆍ보건 감독의 총괄ㆍ조정 및 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management, coordination, and support of workplace safety and health supervision

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업장 안전ㆍ보건 감독계획의 수립ㆍ지도
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and guidance of workplace safety and health supervision plans

rows.source_ko: 4. 사업장 안전ㆍ보건 감독 결과 평가 및 분석에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the evaluation and analysis of workplace safety and health inspection results

rows.source_ko: 5. 「산업안전보건법」에 따른 중대재해(이하 “중대재해”라 한다) 관련 총괄 대응 및 감독계획 수립ㆍ지도
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and guidance of overall response and supervision plans regarding serious accidents (hereinafter referred to as “serious accidents”) pursuant to the Industrial Safety and Health Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 산업안전보건 근로감독관의 업무에 대한 지도 및 역량강화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning guidance on the duties and capacity building of industrial safety and health labor inspectors

rows.source_ko: 7. 산업안전보건 분야 근로감독행정정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment and Operation of the Labor Inspection Administrative Information System in the Sector of Industrial Safety and Health

rows.source_ko: 8. 산업재해 발생보고제도 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the operation of the industrial accident reporting system

rows.source_ko: 9. 안전ㆍ보건 개선계획 및 안전ㆍ보건 진단에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning safety and health improvement plans and safety and health diagnoses

rows.source_ko: 10. 명예산업안전감독관 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the Honorary Industrial Safety Inspector System

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 안전ㆍ보건 감독에 관한 사항으로서 다른 부서의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters concerning safety and health supervision that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other departments

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 중대산업재해수사과장은 다음 사항을 분장 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Serious Industrial Accident Investigation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 중대산업재해 관련 정책의 총괄ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of policies related to serious industrial accidents

rows.source_ko: 2. 중대산업재해 관련 법령 해석ㆍ적용
rows.text_en: 2. Interpretation and Application of Laws Related to Serious Industrial Accidents

rows.source_ko: 3. 「중대재해 처벌 등에 관한 법률」 제정ㆍ개정 등 관계부처 협업에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning collaboration with relevant ministries, such as the enactment and amendment of the "Act on the Punishment, etc. of Serious Accidents"

rows.source_ko: 4. 중대재해 및 중대산업재해 상황 파악 및 대응
rows.text_en: 4. Identification and Response to Serious Accidents and Serious Industrial Accidents

rows.source_ko: 5. 중대재해 및 중대산업재해에 대한 수사 총괄 및 조정ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management, coordination, and support of investigations into serious accidents and serious industrial accidents

rows.source_ko: 6. 중대산업재해 발생에 따른 경영책임자등에 대한 안전보건교육의 실시에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the implementation of safety and health training for management personnel, etc. following the occurrence of serious industrial accidents

rows.source_ko: 7. 중대산업재해 발생사실 공표에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the public disclosure of the occurrence of serious industrial accidents

rows.source_ko: 8. 중대재해 및 중대산업재해 관련 근로감독관의 수사 업무에 대한 지도
rows.text_en: 8. Guidance on the investigative duties of labor inspectors regarding serious accidents and serious industrial accidents

rows.source_ko: 9. 「중대재해 처벌 등에 관한 법률」 준수를 위한 교육ㆍ홍보(중대산업재해에 관한 사항에 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 9. Education and publicity for compliance with the Act on the Punishment, etc. of Serious Accidents (limited to matters concerning serious industrial accidents)

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 중대산업재해에 관한 사항으로서 다른 부서의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters concerning serious industrial accidents that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other departments

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 건설산재예방감독과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Construction Industrial Accident Prevention and Supervision Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 건설업 산업안전정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Implementation of Industrial Safety Policies for the Construction Industry

rows.source_ko: 2. 건설업 안전ㆍ보건 감독계획의 수립ㆍ지도
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and guidance of safety and health supervision plans for the construction industry

rows.source_ko: 3. 건설업 중대재해 관련 대응 및 감독계획 수립ㆍ지도
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and guidance of response and supervision plans regarding serious accidents in the construction industry

rows.source_ko: 4. 건설업 산업안전기준에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning industrial safety standards for the construction industry

rows.source_ko: 5. 건설재해예방전문지도기관 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the system of specialized guidance agencies for construction accident prevention

rows.source_ko: 6. 산업안전보건관리비 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the industrial safety and health management cost system

rows.source_ko: 7. 건설근로자 기초안전교육 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the basic safety education system for construction workers

rows.source_ko: 8. 건설업 유해ㆍ위험방지계획서 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the hazardous and dangerous prevention plan system for the construction industry

rows.source_ko: 9. 건설공사발주자의 산업재해 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the prevention of industrial accidents by the client of construction projects

rows.source_ko: 10. 건설업 안전관리자 제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the construction industry safety manager system

rows.source_ko: 11. 건설사업장에 대한 안전분야 기술지도 및 재정지원
rows.text_en: 11. Technical guidance and financial support in the safety sector for construction sites

rows.source_ko: 12. 타워크레인 설치 및 해체 작업의 안전관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning safety management of tower crane installation and dismantling operations

rows.source_ko: 13. 그 밖에 건설업 산업재해 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Other matters concerning the prevention of industrial accidents in the construction industry

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 화학사고예방조사과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Chemical Accident Prevention and Investigation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 화재ㆍ폭발 및 누출 등 중대산업사고 예방 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of policies for the prevention of major industrial accidents, such as fires, explosions, and leaks

rows.source_ko: 2. 화재ㆍ폭발 및 누출 위험방지 관련 산업안전 기준에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning industrial safety standards related to the prevention of fire, explosion, and leakage risks

rows.source_ko: 3. 화재ㆍ폭발 및 누출 사고 대응 및 원인조사, 분석에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning response to fire, explosion, and leakage accidents, as well as cause investigation and analysis

rows.source_ko: 4. 공정안전관리(PSM)에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning Process Safety Management (PSM)

rows.source_ko: 5. 유해인자의 유해성ㆍ위험성 조사 및 평가 관련 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters related to the investigation and assessment of the hazards and risks of hazardous substances

rows.source_ko: 6. 화학물질 분류 표시에 관한 국제기준(GHS) 운영 및 국가간 협력강화 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the operation of the Globally Harmonized System (GHS) for the classification and labeling of chemical substances and the strengthening of international cooperation, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 물질안전보건자료 및 경고표시에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning Material Safety Data Sheets and warning labels

rows.source_ko: 8. 안전ㆍ보건표지에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning safety and health signs

rows.source_ko: 9. 화학물질 유해성ㆍ위험성 정보 제공에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the provision of information on the hazards and risks of chemical substances

rows.source_ko: 10. 사업장 재난대응에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning workplace disaster response

rows.source_ko: 11. 유해작업 도급금지 및 승인에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the prohibition of subcontracting hazardous work and approval

rows.source_ko: 12. 그 밖에 화학물질의 안전보건에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Other matters concerning the safety and health of chemical substances
[This Article Newly Inserted Oct. 1, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(고용보험심사위원회 상임위원) ① 「고용보험법」 제99조에 따라 고용노동부에 두는 고용보험심사위원회 상임위원은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보한다. <개정 2010. 7. 12., 2013. 12. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Standing Members of the Employment Insurance Review Committee) ① Standing members of the Employment Insurance Review Committee established within the Ministry of Employment and Labor pursuant to Article 99 of the Employment Insurance Act shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service. <Amended July 12, 2010; December 11, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 상임위원의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The job grade of a Standing Member shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>
Chapter 3 Deleted <February 29, 2016>
Article 11 Deleted <February 29, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제4장 지방고용노동관서 <개정 2010. 7. 12.>
rows.text_en: Chapter 4 Regional Employment and Labor Offices <Amended July 12, 2010>

rows.source_ko: 제12조(지방고용노동청ㆍ지청 및 출장소의 명칭ㆍ위치 및 관할 구역) ① 지방고용노동청ㆍ지청 및 출장소의 명칭ㆍ위치 및 관할 구역은 별표 1과 같다. 다만, 지방고용노동청ㆍ지청 및 출장소에 두는 고용센터의 명칭 및 위치는 별표 2와 같다. <개정 2010. 7. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Names, Locations, and Jurisdictional Areas of Regional Employment and Labor Offices, Branch Offices, and Sub-offices) ① The names, locations, and jurisdictional areas of Regional Employment and Labor Offices, Branch Offices, and Sub-offices are as set forth in Table 1. However, the names and locations of Employment Centers established within Regional Employment and Labor Offices, Branch Offices, and Sub-officesare as set forth in Table 2. <Amended July 12, 2010>

rows.source_ko: ② 지방고용노동청장 소속 지청 및 출장소의 범위는 별표 3과 같다. <개정 2010. 7. 12.>
rows.text_en: ② The scope of branch offices and sub-offices under the jurisdiction of the Regional Employment and Labor Office Director is as set forth in Attached Table 3. <Amended July 12, 2010>
[Title amended July 12, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(지방고용노동청장) ① 지방고용노동청장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보한다. <개정 2010. 7. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Head of Regional Employment and Labor Office) ① The Head of a Regional Employment and Labor Office shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service. <Amended July 12, 2010>

rows.source_ko: ② 지방고용노동청장의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2010. 7. 12.>
rows.text_en: ② The job grade of the Head of the Regional Employment and Labor Office shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Jul. 12, 2010>
[Title amended July 12, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(지방고용노동청에 두는 과) ① 지방고용노동청에 두는 과(고용센터, 노동기준조사센터 및 산재예방감독팀을 포함한다)는 별표 4와 같다. 다만, 지역 노사관계 안정을 위하여 필요한 경우에는 지방고용노동청장은 노동기준조사1과에 제8항 각 호에 관한 사무를 전담하는 팀을 설치ㆍ운영할 수 있다. <개정 2009. 4. 30., 2009. 8. 6., 2010. 2. 24., 2010. 7. 12., 2010. 8. 23., 2011. 3. 2., 2011. 4. 26., 2015. 1. 30., 2016. 2. 29., 2016. 7. 1., 2021. 7. 1., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Divisions in Regional Employment and Labor Offices) ① The divisions in Regional Employment and Labor Offices (including employment centers, labor standards investigation centers, and industrial accident prevention supervision teams) are as set forth in Table 4. However, if necessary for the stability of regional labor-management relations, the head of the Regional Employment and Labor Office may establish and operate a team dedicated to the affairs of each subparagraph of Paragraph 8 within Labor Standards Investigation Division 1. <Amended Apr. 30, 2009; Aug. 6, 2009; Feb. 24, 2010; Jul. 12, 2010; Aug. 23, 2010; Mar. 2, 2011; Apr. 26, 2011; Jan. 30, 2015; Feb. 29, 2016; Jul. 1, 2016; Jul. 1, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 고용센터 소장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ행정주사 또는 직업상담주사로, 지역협력과장, 고용관리과장, 부정수급조사과장, 노사상생지원과장, 근로문화개선지원과장, 노동기준조사1과장, 노동기준조사2과장, 노동기준조사3과장, 제주노동기준조사센터 소장, 광역노동기준감독과장, 광역산재예방감독과장, 중대재해수사과장, 중대재해수사1과장, 중대재해수사2과장, 산재예방감독과장 및 건설산재예방감독과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 통계사무관으로, 취업지원총괄과장, 실업급여과장, 국민취업지원과장, 기업지원과장 및 직업능력개발과장은 공업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 통계사무관으로, 제주산재예방감독팀장은 공업주사ㆍ보건주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 행정주사로 보한다. 다만, 제1항 단서에 따라 운영하는 팀의 팀장은 노동기준조사1과장이 겸임한다. <개정 2009. 4. 30., 2009. 8. 6., 2010. 2. 24., 2010. 7. 12., 2011. 3. 2., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 1. 30., 2016. 2. 29., 2016. 7. 1., 2020. 12. 29., 2021. 2. 9., 2021. 2. 25., 2021. 7. 1., 2022. 12. 13., 2023. 4. 11., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 9. 26., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the Employment Center shall be a Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Administrative Officer, Administrative Assistant, or Vocational Counseling Assistant; the Head of the Regional Cooperation Division, Head of the Employment Management Division, Head of the Fraudulent Benefit Investigation Division, Head of the Labor-Management Coexistence Support Division, Head of the Labor Culture Improvement Support Division, Head of the Labor Standards Investigation Division 1, Head of the Labor Standards Investigation Division 2, Head of the Labor Standards Investigation Division 3, Director of the Jeju Labor Standards Investigation Center, Head of the Metropolitan Labor Standards Supervision Division, Head of the Metropolitan Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Division, Head of the Serious Accident Investigation Division, Head of the Serious Accident Investigation Division 1, Head of the Serious Accident Investigation Division 2, Head of the Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Division, and Head of the Construction Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Division shall be a Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Health Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, or Statistics Officer; and the Head of the General Employment Support Division, Head of the Unemployment Benefits Division, Head of the National Employment Support Division, Head of the Enterprise Support Division, and Head of the Vocational Competency Development Division shall be appointed as an Industrial Officer, Health Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, or Statistics Officer; and the Head of the Jeju Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Team shall be appointed as an Industrial Assistant, Health Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Administrative Assistant. However, the head of the team operated pursuant to the proviso of Paragraph 1 shall concurrently serve as the head of the Labor Standards Investigation Division 1. <Amended Apr. 30, 2009; Aug. 6, 2009; Feb. 24, 2010; Jul. 12, 2010; Mar. 2, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013; Jan. 30, 2015; Feb. 29, 2016; Jul. 1, 2016; Dec. 29, 2020; Feb. 9, 2021; Feb. 25, 2021; Jul. 1, 2021; Dec. 13, 2022; Apr. 11, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023; Sep. 26, 2023; Dec. 30, 2025>

③ The Director of the Employment Center shall be responsible for the following matters. Provided, however, that these matters be limited to the affairs of the region designated and notified by the Minister of Employment and Labor. <Amended Jan. 30, 2015; Jul. 1, 2016; Sep. 16, 2020; Dec. 29, 2020; Jan. 27, 2022; Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 자체 고용대책 수립

rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning job registration, employment counseling and placement, training counseling, and provision of employment information

rows.text_en: 4. Operation of career guidance programs, such as group counseling programs and special lectures on employment support

rows.source_ko: 5. 진로지도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning career guidance

rows.source_ko: 6. 직업상담원 교육훈련 및 성과평가 등에 관한 업무

rows.source_ko: 6의2. 취업알선 처리 등의 모니터링에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6-2. Matters concerning monitoring of job placement processing, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 실업급여 수급자격 인정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the recognition of eligibility for unemployment benefits

rows.source_ko: 8. 실업인정 및 실업급여 지급에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning recognition of unemployment and payment of unemployment benefits

rows.source_ko: 9. 실업급여 수급자 취업지원 프로그램 제공 및 취업알선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the provision of employment support programs and job placement for unemployment benefit recipients

rows.source_ko: 10. 실업급여 수급자 집단상담 프로그램 및 취업지원특강 등 진로지도 프로그램의 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Operation of career guidance programs, such as group counseling programs for unemployment benefit recipients and special lectures on employment support

rows.source_ko: 11. 실업급여 수급자격자의 재취업 설명회의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the operation of re-employment information sessions for eligible unemployment benefit recipients

rows.source_ko: 12. 「구직자취업촉진 및 생활안정지원에 관한 법률」에 따른 취업취약계층 지원
rows.text_en: 12. Support for vulnerable employment groups pursuant to the Act on Promotion of Employment and Support for Livelihood Stabilization of Job Seekers

rows.source_ko: 13. 「국민기초생활보장법」에 따른 자활 대상자의 고용 지원
rows.text_en: 13. Employment support for self-sufficiency recipients under the National Basic Living Security Act

rows.source_ko: 14. 고용서비스기관과 자활지원기관 등 유관기관 간 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning cooperation between relevant institutions, such as employment service agencies and self-reliance support agencies

rows.source_ko: 15. 중ㆍ장년, 청년 등 취약계층의 취업지원
rows.text_en: 15. Employment support for vulnerable groups, including middle-aged and older adults and youth

rows.source_ko: 16. 고용안정사업에 관한 집행 및 관리
rows.text_en: 16. Execution and Management of Employment Stability Programs

rows.source_ko: 17. 고용촉진을 위한 제도의 집행 및 관리
rows.text_en: 17. Implementation and Management of Employment Promotion Systems

rows.source_ko: 18. 근로시간 단축제도 활성화 및 고용문화 개선 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Matters concerning support for the promotion of the working hours reduction system and improvement of employment culture

rows.source_ko: 19. 고용안정ㆍ촉진을 위한 지역경제단체와의 협력
rows.text_en: 19. Cooperation with local economic organizations for employment stability and promotion

rows.source_ko: 20. 「고용보험법」 제3장에 따른 고용안정사업 중 같은 법 시행령 제145조에 따라 직업안정기관의 장에게 위임된 사항
rows.text_en: 20. Among the employment stability projects under Chapter 3 of the Employment Insurance Act, matters delegated to the head of the job security agency pursuant to Article 145 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act

rows.source_ko: 21. 「고용보험법」 제5장, 제5장의2 및 제5장의3에 따른 육아휴직 급여 등에 대한 사업 중 같은 법 시행령 제145조에 따라 직업안정기관의 장에게 위임된 사항
rows.text_en: 21. Among the programs regarding parental leave benefits, etc. under Chapters 5, 5-2, and 5-3 of the Employment Insurance Act, matters delegated to the head of the employment security agency pursuant to Article 145 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act.

rows.source_ko: 22. 직업능력개발을 하는 근로자에 대한 비용지원
rows.text_en: 22. Financial support for workers engaged in vocational competency development

rows.source_ko: 23. 직업능력개발훈련 실시자에 대한 상담ㆍ지도 및 직업능력개발훈련에 관한 홍보
rows.text_en: 23. Counseling and guidance for vocational competency development training implementers and promotion of vocational competency development training

rows.source_ko: 24. 국가직무능력표준(NCS) 및 일학습병행제 확산 지원
rows.text_en: 24. Support for the expansion of the National Competency Standards (NCS) and the Work-Study Parallel System

rows.source_ko: 25. 일학습병행 지역단위 운영협의회 운영 등 유관기관 협력
rows.text_en: 25. Cooperation with relevant organizations, such as the operation of regional work-study program steering councils

rows.source_ko: 26. 학습근로자의 기업과의 연계 및 보호 등 관리
rows.text_en: 26. Management of apprentices, including linkage with companies and protection

rows.source_ko: 27. 「국가기술자격법」에 따른 자격대여자에 대한 조사 및 행정처분, 신고포상금 지급
rows.text_en: 27. Investigation and administrative disposition against qualification lenders pursuant to the National Technical Qualifications Act , and payment of rewards for reporting

rows.source_ko: 28.「산업현장 일학습병행 지원에 관한 법률 시행령」 제17조제1항에 따라 지방고용노동관서의 장에게 위임된 사항
rows.text_en: 28. Matters delegated to the head of the local employment and labor office pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Support for Work-Study Programs in Industrial Sites

rows.source_ko: ④ 취업지원총괄과장은 제3항제1호부터 제6호까지 및 제6호의2의 업무에 관하여, 실업급여과장은 같은 항 제7호부터 제11호까지의 업무에 관하여, 국민취업지원과장은 같은 항 제12호부터 제15호까지의 업무에 관하여, 기업지원과장은 같은 항 제16호부터 제21호까지의 업무에 관하여, 직업능력개발과장은 같은 항 제22호부터 제28호까지의 업무에 관하여 각각 고용센터 소장을 보조한다. <신설 2015. 1. 30., 2020. 12. 29., 2021. 2. 9., 2022. 1. 27., 2023. 9. 26.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the General Employment Support Division assists the Director of the Employment Center with respect to the duties under Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 1 through 6 and 6-2; the Head of the Unemployment Benefits Division assists the Director of the Employment Center with respect to the duties under Subparagraphs 7 through 11 of the same paragraph; the Head of the National Employment Support Division assists the Director of the Employment Center with respect to the duties under Subparagraphs 12 through 15 of the same paragraph; the Head of the Enterprise Support Division assists the Director of the Employment Center with respect to the duties under Subparagraphs 16 through 21 of the same paragraph; and the Head of the Vocational Competency Development Division assists the Director of the Employment Center with respect to the duties under Subparagraphs 22 through 28 of the same paragraph. <Newly added Jan. 30, 2015; Dec. 29, 2020; Feb. 9, 2021; Jan. 27, 2022; Sep. 26, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 지역협력과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2015. 1. 30., 2018. 12. 5.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Regional Cooperation Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly established Jan. 30, 2015; Dec. 5, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 지역 맞춤형 일자리 지원 사업
rows.text_en: 1. Region-Specific Job Support Program

rows.source_ko: 2. 지역 및 산업계가 주도하는 인력양성의 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Support for workforce development led by local communities and industries

rows.source_ko: 3. 지역일자리 목표 공시제 사업(고용형태 공시제를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Regional Job Target Disclosure System Project (including Employment Type Disclosure System)

rows.source_ko: 4. 사회적기업 육성 지원 및 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 4. Support for fostering social enterprises and guidance and supervision

rows.source_ko: 5. 지역고용심의회 및 실무위원회의 운영지원
rows.text_en: 5. Operational support for the Regional Employment Council and Working Committee

rows.source_ko: 6. 고용서비스 관련 지방자치단체, 소속 공공기관 및 유관기관과의 협력사업
rows.text_en: 6. Cooperation projects with local governments, affiliated public institutions, and related organizations regarding employment services

rows.source_ko: 7. 고용동향 분석 및 고용노동통계 조사
rows.text_en: 7. Analysis of Employment Trends and Employment and Labor Statistics Survey

rows.source_ko: 8. 대량고용변동 신고 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 8. Tasks related to reporting mass employment changes

rows.source_ko: 9. 고령자 고용현황 및 정년제도 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Employment Status of Older Workers and Operation of Retirement System

rows.source_ko: 10. 장애인고용의무제 실시 지도
rows.text_en: 10. Guidance on the Implementation of the Mandatory Employment System for Persons with Disabilities

rows.source_ko: 11. 고용창출 100대 우수기업 후보에 대한 고용증가 사유, 고용형태, 근로조건 등 현장조사
rows.text_en: 11. On-site investigation of reasons for employment growth, employment types, working conditions, etc., for candidates for the Top 100 Excellent Job Creation Companies

rows.source_ko: 12. 일자리 창출 유공 포상 후보 발굴 및 추천
rows.text_en: 12. Identification and Recommendation of Candidates for Awards for Meritorious Service in Job Creation

rows.source_ko: 13. 외국인근로자 고용허가 및 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning the employment permit and management of foreign workers

rows.source_ko: 14. 소속 지청 및 출장소의 장애인고용의무제 실시 지도업무에 대한 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 14. Overall management and coordination of guidance duties regarding the implementation of the Mandatory Employment System for Persons with Disabilities by affiliated branch offices and sub-offices

rows.source_ko: 15. 직장 내 장애인 인식개선 교육 이행 지원
rows.text_en: 15. Support for the Implementation of Workplace Disability Awareness Training

rows.source_ko: 16. 중증장애인 지역 맞춤형 취업지원 사업의 지원
rows.text_en: 16. Support for the Region-Specific Employment Support Program for People with Severe Disabilities
⑥ The Head of the Employment Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 30, 2015; Apr. 13, 2021; Feb. 22, 2022; Apr. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 보안 및 관인관리
rows.text_en: 1. Security and Official Seal Management

rows.source_ko: 2. 기록물의 접수ㆍ발송ㆍ심사ㆍ발간 및 보존
rows.text_en: 2. Receipt, dispatch, examination, publication, and preservation of records

rows.source_ko: 3. 공무원의 임용ㆍ교육훈련ㆍ연금ㆍ급여ㆍ복지 및 그 밖의 인사사무
rows.text_en: 3. Appointment, education and training, pension, salary, welfare, and other personnel affairs of public officials

rows.source_ko: 4. 직업상담원 등 근로자의 채용ㆍ승진ㆍ급여ㆍ복무ㆍ복지 및 그 밖의 인사사무
rows.text_en: 4. Recruitment, promotion, salary, service, welfare, and other personnel affairs of workers, such as career counselors

rows.source_ko: 5. 예산ㆍ회계 및 결산
rows.text_en: 5. Budget, Accounting, and Settlement

rows.source_ko: 6. 국유재산 및 물품관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of State-Owned Property and Goods

rows.source_ko: 7. 감사 및 사정업무
rows.text_en: 7. Audit and Inspection Affairs

rows.source_ko: 8. 청사와 시설의 관리 및 방호
rows.text_en: 8. Management and security of office buildings and facilities

rows.source_ko: 9. 소관 회계ㆍ기금의 수입 및 징수, 체납처분, 과태료 및 채권의 관리, 결손처분에 관한 사항(지방고용노동청의 경우에는 소속 지청 및 출장소로부터 이관 받은 과태료 및 채권의 관리, 결손처분에 관한 사항을 포함하고, 강원지청의 경우에는 강원특별자치도에 있는 다른 지청 및 출장소로부터 이관 받은 과태료 및 채권의 관리, 결손처분에 관한 사항을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the revenue and collection of accounts and funds under its jurisdiction, enforcement of delinquent payments, management of administrative fines and claims, and write-offs (in the case of a Regional Employment and Labor Office, matters concerning the management of administrative fines and claims and write-offs transferred from affiliated branch offices and sub-offices; in the case of the Gangwon Branch Office, matters concerning the management of administrative fines and claims and write-offs transferred from other branch offices and sub-offices located in Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province)

rows.source_ko: 10. 고용노동행정업무 행정관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the administrative management of employment and labor administration affairs

rows.source_ko: 11. 성과관리 및 평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning performance management and evaluation

rows.source_ko: 12. 직원역량강화를 위한 지원업무
rows.text_en: 12. Support tasks for employee competency enhancement

rows.source_ko: 13. 고객만족도 제고 등 고객관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning customer management, such as improving customer satisfaction

rows.source_ko: 14. 주요사업계획의 수립ㆍ조정 및 심사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 14. Establishment, coordination, review, and analysis of major business plans

rows.source_ko: 15. 고용보험 피보험자에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning insured persons under employment insurance

rows.source_ko: 16. 고용보험사무조합의 피보험자 관리업무처리 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 16. Guidance and supervision of the Employment Insurance Administration Union's handling of insured person management tasks

rows.source_ko: 17. 「직업안정법」에 따른 허가ㆍ신고 및 등록 등에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 17. Matters concerning permits, notifications, and registrations, etc. under the Employment Security Act

rows.source_ko: 18. 국외 취업근로자의 모집신고에 관한 사항

rows.source_ko: 5. 「산업안전보건법 시행령」 제13조에 해당하는 건설회사의 안전 및 보건에 관한 계획의 이사회 보고ㆍ승인에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the reporting to and approval by the Board of Directors of a construction company's safety and health plan falling under Article 13 of the Enforcement Decree of the Industrial Safety and Health Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 「중대재해 처벌 등에 관한 법률」 제4조에 따른 건설업의 안전보건관리체계 구축 및 확산 지원
rows.text_en: 6. Support for the establishment and dissemination of safety and health management systems in the construction industry pursuant to Article 4 of the Act on the Punishment, etc. of Serious Accidents

rows.source_ko: 6의2. 「산업재해보상보험법」 제111조의2에 따른 보험급여 신청을 이유로 한 불이익 처우의 금지와 같은 법 제127조제3항제3호에 따른 불이익 처우를 한 사업주에 대한 벌칙과 관련된 지도ㆍ조사(건설업에 관한 사항으로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 6-2. Guidance and investigation regarding the prohibition of disadvantageous treatment for reasons of applying for insurance benefits under Article 111-2 of the Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance Act and penalties against employers who have committed disadvantageous treatment under Article 127, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 3 of the same Act (limited to matters concerning the construction industry)

rows.source_ko: 7. 건설재해예방전문기관, 건설안전진단기관, 타워크레인 설치ㆍ해체업, 석면조사기관 및 석면해체제거업자의 인가ㆍ허가ㆍ승인ㆍ확인ㆍ지정 및 등록에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the authorization, permission, approval, verification, designation, and registration of specialized construction disaster prevention agencies, construction safety diagnostic agencies, tower crane installation and dismantling businesses, asbestos survey agencies, and asbestos removal businesses

rows.source_ko: 8. 건설공사발주자의 산업안전보건법령 위반에 대한 조치
rows.text_en: 8. Measures against violations of industrial safety and health laws by the client of a construction project

rows.source_ko: 9. 지방자치단체 등 건설 유관기관과의 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning cooperation with construction-related organizations, such as local governments

rows.source_ko: 10. 건설안전 분야 산업안전지도사 등록 및 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Registration and Management of Industrial Safety Instructors in the Construction Safety Field

rows.source_ko: 11. 건설업 명예산업안전감독관 위촉ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 11. Appointment and Operation of Honorary Industrial Safety Supervisors for the Construction Industry

rows.source_ko: 11의2. 지방고용노동청 관할 구역[소속 지청(경기ㆍ성남ㆍ안양ㆍ안산ㆍ평택 지청은 제외한다) 및 출장소의 관할구역을 포함한다] 내 특별감독 및 결과조치(건설업에 관한 사항으로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 11-2. Special supervision and resulting measures within the jurisdiction of the Regional Employment and Labor Office [including the jurisdiction of affiliated branch offices (excluding the Gyeonggi, Seongnam, Anyang, Ansan, and Pyeongtaek branch offices) and sub-offices] (limited to matters concerning the construction industry)

rows.source_ko: 11의3. 석면조사 및 석면해체ㆍ제거작업의 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11-3. Matters concerning the management of asbestos surveys and asbestos dismantling and removal work

rows.source_ko: 11의4. 건설업 산업재해예방 활동 및 교육ㆍ홍보ㆍ지도
rows.text_en: 11-4. Industrial Accident Prevention Activities and Education, Promotion, and Guidance in the Construction Industry

rows.source_ko: 11의5. 건설업 감독 총괄 및 실시, 건설업 산업재해 예방 순찰 점검
rows.text_en: 11-5. Overall management and implementation of construction industry supervision, and patrol inspections for the prevention of industrial accidents in the construction industry

rows.source_ko: 11의6. 건설업 안전일터 신고센터 신고사항 처리
rows.text_en: 11-6. Processing of Reports to the Construction Industry Safety Workplace Reporting Center

rows.source_ko: 11의7. 건설업 관련 중대재해 조사 및 수사 등 업무 일체(「중대재해 처벌 등에 관한 법률」 제2조제2호에 따른 중대산업재해에 관한 사항은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 11-7. All duties regarding the investigation and prosecution of serious accidents related to the construction industry ( excluding matters concerning serious industrial accidents pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Act on the Punishment, etc. of Serious Accidents )

rows.source_ko: 12. 그 밖에 건설업의 산재예방 조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Other matters concerning industrial accident prevention measures in the construction industry
[Title amended July 12, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제14조의2(지청장 및 출장소장) 지청장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보하되, 강릉지청장ㆍ태백지청장ㆍ영주지청장ㆍ안동지청장 및 영월출장소장은 공업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 통계사무관으로 보한다. 다만, 강원지청장 및 울산지청장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제3항에 따라 상호 이체하여 운영하는 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보할 수 있고, 강릉지청장은 같은 규정에 따라 상호 이체하여 운영하는 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 통계사무관으로 보할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 12. 11., 2019. 6. 3., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 29., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 14-2 (Heads of Branch Offices and Sub-offices) Heads of branch offices shall be appointed as science and technology secretaries or secretaries, provided that the heads of the Gangneung, Taebaek, Yeongju, and Andong branch offices and the Yeongwol sub-office shall be appointed as industrial officers, health officers, facilities officers, computer officers, administrative officers, or statistics officers. However, the heads of the Gangwon and Ulsan branch offices may be appointed as deputy directors, science and technology secretaries, or secretaries who are transferred between each other in accordance with Article 27, Paragraph 3 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies , and the head of the Gangneung branch office may be appointed as science and technology secretaries, secretaries, industrial officers, health officers, facilities officers, computer officers, administrative officers, or statistics officers who are transferred between each other in accordance with the same regulations. <Amended Dec. 11, 2013; Jun. 3, 2019; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 29, 2023; Dec. 30, 2025>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 5, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제15조(지청 및 출장소에 두는 과) ① 지청 및 출장소에 두는 과(고용센터 및 팀을 포함한다)는 별표 4와 같다. 다만, 지역 노사관계 안정을 위하여 필요한 경우에는 지청장(노사상생지원과를 두는 지청의 장은 제외한다) 및 출장소장은 노동기준조사과 또는 노동기준조사1과에 제4항 각 호에 따른 사무를 전담하는 팀을 설치ㆍ운영할 수 있다. <개정 2009. 4. 30., 2010. 2. 24., 2010. 7. 12., 2011. 3. 2., 2011. 4. 26., 2015. 1. 30., 2016. 7. 1., 2021. 7. 1., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Divisions in Branch Offices and Sub-offices) ① The divisions (including employment centers and teams) in branch offices and sub-offices shall be as set forth in Attached Table 4. However, if necessary for the stability of regional labor-management relations, the head of a branch office (excluding the head of a branch office that has a Labor-Management Coexistence Support Division) and the head of a sub-office may establish and operate a team dedicated to the duties under each subparagraph of Paragraph 4 within the Labor Standards Investigation Division or Labor Standards Investigation Division 1. <Amended Apr. 30, 2009; Feb. 24, 2010; Jul. 12, 2010; Mar. 2, 2011; Apr. 26, 2011; Jan. 30, 2015; Jul. 1, 2016; Jul. 1, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 고용센터 소장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ통계사무관ㆍ행정주사 또는 직업상담주사로, 지역협력과장, 고용관리과장, 노사상생지원과장, 근로문화개선지원과장, 노동기준조사과장(노동기준조사1과장부터 노동기준조사3과장까지를 포함한다), 노동기준감독과장, 중대재해수사과장, 산재예방감독과장 및 건설산재예방감독과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ통계사무관 또는 행정주사로 보하고, 팀장은 공업주사ㆍ보건주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 행정주사로 보한다. 다만, 제1항 단서에 따라 운영하는 팀의 팀장은 노동기준조사과장 또는 노동기준조사1과장이 겸임한다. <개정 2015. 1. 30., 2016. 7. 1., 2021. 2. 25., 2021. 7. 1., 2022. 12. 13., 2023. 4. 11., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the Employment Center shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Health Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, Statistics Officer, Administrative Assistant, or Vocational Counseling Assistant; the Head of the Regional Cooperation Division, the Head of the Employment Management Division, the Head of the Labor-Management Coexistence Support Division, the Head of the Labor Culture Improvement Support Division, the Head of the Labor Standards Investigation Division (including the Heads of Labor Standards Investigation Divisions 1 through 3), the Head of the Labor Standards Supervision Division, the Head of the Serious Accidents Investigation Division, the Head of the Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Division, and the Head of the Construction Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Division shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Health Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, Statistics Officer, or Administrative Assistant; and the Team Leader shall be appointed as an Industrial Assistant, Health Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Administrative Assistant. However, the Team Leader of a team operated pursuant to the proviso of Paragraph 1 shall concurrently hold the position of the Head of the Labor Standards Investigation Division or the Head of Labor Standards Investigation Division 1. <Amended Jan. 30, 2015; Jul. 1, 2016; Feb. 25, 2021; Jul. 1, 2021; Dec. 13, 2022; Apr. 11, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 고용센터 소장, 지역협력과장, 지역협력팀장 및 고용관리과장은 다음 각 호에 따른 사항을 분장한다. 다만, 고용노동부장관이 정하여 고시한 지역의 사무로 한정하고, 고용관리과가 설치되지 아니한 지청 및 출장소는 지역협력과에서 고용관리과의 분장사무를 분장한다. <개정 2015. 1. 30., 2016. 7. 1., 2017. 12. 29., 2018. 3. 30., 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of the Employment Center, the Head of the Regional Cooperation Division, the Head of the Regional Cooperation Team, and the Head of the Employment Management Division shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. However, this shall be limited to regional affairs designated and notified by the Minister of Employment and Labor, and for branch offices and sub-offices where the Employment Management Division is not established, the Regional Cooperation Division shall be responsible for the affairs assigned to the Employment Management Division. <Amended Jan. 30, 2015; Jul. 1, 2016; Dec. 29, 2017; Mar. 30, 2018; Jul. 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고용센터 소장: 제14조제3항 각 호의 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Director of the Employment Center: Matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 14, Paragraph 3

rows.source_ko: 2. 지역협력과장 및 지역협력팀장: 제14조제5항 각 호의 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Head of Regional Cooperation Division and Head of Regional Cooperation Team: Matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 14, Paragraph 5

rows.source_ko: 3. 고용관리과장: 제14조제6항 각 호의 사항 및 같은 조 제7항제1호ㆍ제2호ㆍ제2호의2ㆍ제2호의3의 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Head of Employment Management Division: Matters under each subparagraph of Article 14, Paragraph 6 , and matters under Paragraph 7 , Subparagraphs 1 , 2, 2-2, and 2-3 of the same article

rows.source_ko: ④ 노사상생지원과장은 제14조제8항제1호부터 제22호까지의 사항 중 해당 지청의 관할구역 사업장에 관한 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Labor-Management Cooperation Support Division shall be responsible for matters concerning workplaces within the jurisdiction of the relevant branch office among the matters under Article 14, Paragraph 8 , Subparagraphs 1 through 22. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 근로문화개선지원과장은 제14조제9항제1호부터 제6호까지의 사항 중 해당 지청의 관할 구역에 관한 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2021. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Labor Culture Improvement Support Division shall be responsible for matters concerning the jurisdictional areas of the relevant branch office among the matters under Article 14, Paragraph 9 , Subparagraphs 1 through 6. <Newly added Feb. 25, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 노동기준조사과장(노동기준조사1과장부터 노동기준조사3과장까지를 포함한다) 및 노동기준조사팀장은 다음 사항을 분장하며, 지청장은 업무량 등을 고려하여 노동기준조사1과장부터 노동기준조사3과장까지의 담당 지역 등을 정할 수 있다. 다만, 서울강남ㆍ성남ㆍ창원ㆍ울산ㆍ천안 지청의 노동기준조사과장은 근로문화개선지원과장이 분장하는 사무와 관련되는 사무는 제외한 사무를 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Heads of the Labor Standards Investigation Divisions (including the Heads of Labor Standards Investigation Divisions 1 through 3) and the Labor Standards Investigation Team Leaders shall be responsible for the following matters, and the Branch Office Director may determine the areas of responsibility for the Heads of Labor Standards Investigation Divisions 1 through 3 in consideration of workload, etc. However, the Heads of the Labor Standards Investigation Divisions of the Seoul Gangnam, Seongnam, Changwon, Ulsan, and Cheonan Branch Offices shall be responsible for duties excluding those related to the duties assigned to the Head of the Labor Culture Improvement Support Division. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제14조제10항제1호부터 제19호까지의 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters under Article 14, Paragraph 10 , Subparagraphs 1 through 19

rows.source_ko: 2. 노사상생지원과를 두지 않는 지청 및 출장소의 경우, 14조제8항제1호부터 제15호까지 및 제17호부터 제22호까지의 사항 중 해당 지청 및 출장소의 관할구역 사업장에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of branch offices and sub-offices that do not have a Labor-Management Cooperation Support Division, among the matters under Article 14, Paragraph 8, Subparagraphs 1 through 15 and 17 through 22, matters concerning workplaces within the jurisdiction of the relevant branch office or sub-office.

rows.source_ko: 3. 노동기준감독과를 두지 않는 지청 및 출장소의 경우, 다음 각 목의 사항 중 해당 지청 및 출장소의 관할구역 사업장에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. In the case of branch offices and sub-offices that do not have a Labor Standards Inspection Division, among the matters in each of the following subparagraphs, matters concerning workplaces within the jurisdiction of the relevant branch office or sub-office

rows.source_ko: 가. 제14조제8항제16호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: a. Matters concerning Article 14, Paragraph 8, Subparagraph 16

rows.source_ko: 나. 제14조제10항제1호 및 제5호에 관한 사항 중 지청장이 지정하는 사항
rows.text_en: B. Matters concerning Article 14, Paragraph 10 , Subparagraphs 1 and 5 that are designated by the Branch Office Director

rows.source_ko: 다. 제14조제12항제2호 및 제3호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: C. Matters concerning Article 14, Paragraph 12 , Subparagraphs 2 and 3

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 노동기준감독과장은 다음 각 호의 사항 중 해당 지청의 관할 구역 사업장에 관한 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Labor Standards Inspection Division shall be responsible for matters among the following subparagraphs concerning workplaces within the jurisdiction of the relevant branch office. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제14조제8항제16호에 관한 사항(울산지청은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning Article 14, Paragraph 8, Subparagraph 16 (excluding the Ulsan Branch Office)

rows.source_ko: 2. 제14조제10항제1호 및 제5호에 관한 사항 중 지청장이 지정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning Article 14, Paragraph 10 , Subparagraphs 1 and 5 that are designated by the Branch Office Director

rows.source_ko: 3. 제14조제12항제2호 및 제3호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning Article 14, Paragraph 12 , Subparagraphs 2 and 3

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 중대재해수사과장은 별표 1의2에 따른 지청의 중대재해수사과 관할구역에 관한 제14조제14항제4호부터 제6호까지의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Serious Accidents Investigation Division shall be responsible for the matters under subparagraphs 4 through 6 of Article 14, Paragraph 14, concerning the jurisdictional areas of the Serious Accidents Investigation Divisions of Branch Offices pursuant to Annex 1-2 . <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 산재예방감독과장 및 산재예방감독팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. 다만, 의정부ㆍ고양ㆍ성남ㆍ안양ㆍ평택ㆍ인천북부ㆍ울산ㆍ대구서부ㆍ포항ㆍ전주ㆍ여수ㆍ청주ㆍ천안지청의 산재예방감독과장은 건설산재예방감독과장이 분장하는 사무와 관련되는 사무를 제외한 사무를 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Division and the Team Leaders of the Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Team shall be responsible for the following matters. However, the Heads of the Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Divisions of the Uijeongbu, Goyang, Seongnam, Anyang, Pyeongtaek, Incheon Northern, Ulsan, Daegu Western, Pohang, Jeonju, Yeosu, Cheongju, and Cheonan Branch Offices shall be responsible for duties excluding those related to the duties assigned to the Head of the Construction Industrial Accident Prevention Supervision Division. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제14조제13항제1호부터 제10호까지, 제12호부터 제15호까지 및 제18호부터 제21호까지에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning Article 14, Paragraph 13, Subparagraphs 1 through 10 , 12 through 15, and 18 through 21

rows.source_ko: 2. 제14조제13항제11호의 사항 중 작업환경측정기관, 특수건강진단기관 및 유해위험작업교육기관에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning workplace environment measurement agencies, special health examination agencies, and hazardous work training agencies among the matters under Article 14, Paragraph 13, Subparagraph 11

rows.source_ko: 3. 제14조제15항제3호, 제6호 및 제7호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning Article 14 , Paragraph 15 , Subparagraphs 3, 6 , and 7

rows.source_ko: 4. 제14조제17항제7호의 사항 중 건설재해예방전문기관, 건설안전진단기관 및 석면조사기관을 제외한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters under Article 14, Paragraph 17, Subparagraph 7 , excluding specialized construction disaster prevention agencies, construction safety diagnosis agencies, and asbestos survey agencies

rows.source_ko: 5. 제14조제17항제8호, 제9호, 제11호, 제11호의3 및 제12호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning Article 14 , Paragraph 17, Subparagraphs 8 , 9 , 11 , 11-3 , and 12

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 건설산재예방감독과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Construction Industrial Accident Prevention and Supervision Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제14조제17항제1호, 제3호부터 제11호까지 및 제11호의3부터 제12호까지에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning Article 14 , Paragraph 17 , Subparagraphs 1 , 3 through 11, and 11-3 through 12

rows.source_ko: 2. 제14조제17항제7호의 사항 중 건설재해예방전문기관, 건설안전진단기관 및 석면조사기관을 제외한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters under Article 14, Paragraph 17, Subparagraph 7 , excluding specialized construction disaster prevention agencies, construction safety diagnosis agencies, and asbestos survey agencies

rows.source_ko: 제5장 노동위원회
rows.text_en: Chapter 5 Labor Relations Commission

rows.source_ko: 제16조(중앙노동위원회 상임위원) ① 중앙노동위원회 상임위원은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보한다. <개정 2013. 12. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Standing Members of the Central Labor Relations Commission) ① Standing members of the Central Labor Relations Commission shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service. <Amended Dec. 11, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 상임위원의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The job grade of a Standing Member shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 제17조(중앙노동위원회 조정심판국장) ① 중앙노동위원회 조정심판국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Director of the Mediation and Adjudication Bureau of the Central Labor Relations Commission) ① The Director of the Mediation and Adjudication Bureau of the Central Labor Relations Commission shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service.

rows.source_ko: ② 조정심판국장의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The job grade of the Director of the Mediation and Adjudication Bureau shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 제18조(중앙노동위원회 기획총괄과 및 조정심판국에 두는 과) ① 중앙노동위원회 기획총괄과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Divisions within the Planning and General Affairs Division and the Mediation and Adjudication Bureau of the Central Labor Relations Commission) ① The Head of the Planning and General Affairs Division of the Central Labor Relations Commission shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 중앙노동위원회 조정심판국에 조정과ㆍ교섭대표결정과ㆍ심판1과ㆍ심판2과 및 법무지원과를 둔다. <개정 2011. 3. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mediation and Adjudication Bureau of the Central Labor Relations Commission shall have a Mediation Division, a Determination of Bargaining Representative Division, Adjudication Division 1, Adjudication Division 2, and a Legal Support Division. <Amended Mar. 2, 2011>

rows.source_ko: ③ 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 법무지원과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2009. 11. 10., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Each Division Head shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary, and the Head of the Legal Support Division shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Administrative Officer. <Amended Nov. 10, 2009; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ④ 조정과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2011. 3. 2.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Coordination Manager shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 2, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 1. 조정사건
rows.text_en: 1. Mediation case

rows.source_ko: 2. 중재사건
rows.text_en: 2. Arbitration Case

rows.source_ko: 3. 긴급조정사건
rows.text_en: 3. Emergency mediation cases

rows.source_ko: 4. 필수유지업무의 유지ㆍ운영수준 결정 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the determination of maintenance and operation levels of essential services, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4의2. 조정분야 업무계획 수립 및 처리지침에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4-2. Matters concerning the establishment of work plans and processing guidelines for the coordination field

rows.source_ko: 4의3. 조정제도의 연구 및 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4-3. Matters concerning the research and improvement of the mediation system

rows.source_ko: 5. 조정위원회ㆍ중재위원회ㆍ특별조정위원회ㆍ교원노동관계조정위원회 및 공무원노동관계조정위원회의 구성ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the composition and operation of the Mediation Committee, Arbitration Committee, Special Mediation Committee, Teachers' Labor Relations Mediation Committee, and Public Officials' Labor Relations Mediation Committee

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 교섭대표결정과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2011. 3. 2., 2015. 8. 24.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director of the Determination of Negotiating Representatives shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Mar. 2, 2011; Aug. 24, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 노동조합 교섭요구 사실의 공고 및 교섭요구 노동조합 확정 공고 관련 시정요청의 결정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the decision on a request for correction regarding the public announcement of the fact of a labor union's demand for bargaining and the public announcement confirming the labor union demanding bargaining

rows.source_ko: 2. 조합원 수의 과반수로 조직된 노동조합의 결정 등 교섭대표노동조합의 결정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the determination of the bargaining representative labor union, such as the determination of the labor union organized by a majority of the number of members

rows.source_ko: 3. 조합원 수의 비율에 의한 공동교섭대표단의 구성 결정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the determination of the composition of the joint bargaining delegation based on the ratio of the number of union members

rows.source_ko: 4. 교섭단위 분리의 결정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the decision on the separation of bargaining units

rows.source_ko: 4의2. 공정대표의무 위반에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4-2. Matters concerning violation of the duty of fair representation

rows.source_ko: 4의3. 부당노동행위 구제에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4-3. Matters concerning relief from unfair labor practices

rows.source_ko: 4의4. 단체협약 해석 등에 대한 견해 제시에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4-4. Matters concerning the presentation of opinions regarding the interpretation of collective agreements, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4의5. 노사협의회 의결사항의 중재에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4-5. Matters concerning the arbitration of resolutions of the Labor-Management Council

rows.source_ko: 5. 교섭대표노동조합 결정, 공정대표의무 위반, 부당노동행위 구제 등 관련 분야 업무계획 수립 및 처리지침에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the establishment of work plans and processing guidelines in related fields, such as the determination of the bargaining representative labor union, violations of the duty of fair representation, and relief from unfair labor practices

rows.source_ko: 6. 교섭대표노동조합 결정, 공정대표의무 위반, 부당노동행위 구제 등 관련 분야의 연구 및 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning research and improvement in related fields, such as the determination of the bargaining representative labor union, violations of the duty of fair representation, and relief from unfair labor practices

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 교섭대표노동조합 결정, 공정대표의무 위반, 부당노동행위 구제 업무 및 교섭대표결정위원회 구성ㆍ운영 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters concerning the determination of the bargaining representative labor union, violations of the duty of fair representation, relief for unfair labor practices, and the composition and operation of the Bargaining Representative Determination Committee.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 심판 1과장 및 심판 2과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2011. 3. 2., 2015. 8. 24.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Heads of the First and Second Appeal Divisions shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 2, 2011; Aug. 24, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 부당해고 구제에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning relief for unfair dismissal

rows.source_ko: 2. 부당해고 구제명령의 불이행에 따른 이행강제금 부과에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the imposition of enforcement fines for non-compliance with an unfair dismissal remedy order

rows.source_ko: 3. 근로조건위반으로 인한 손해배상 청구에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning claims for damages due to violation of working conditions

rows.source_ko: 4. 기준에 못 미치는 휴업수당 지급 승인에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the approval of payment of layoff allowances that fall short of the standards

rows.source_ko: 5. 휴업보상 또는 장해보상 예외인정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the recognition of exceptions to compensation for temporary loss of income or disability compensation
6. Deleted <Aug. 24, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 8. 비정규직 차별시정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the rectification of discrimination against non-regular workers

rows.source_ko: 9. 심판분야 업무계획 수립 및 처리지침 마련에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the establishment of work plans and preparation of processing guidelines for the adjudication field

rows.source_ko: 10. 심판제도의 연구 및 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the research and improvement of the adjudication system

rows.source_ko: 12. 그 밖에 심판위원회 및 차별시정위원회 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Other matters concerning the operation of the Adjudication Committee and the Discrimination Correction Committee

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 법무지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2011. 3. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Legal Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 2, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 1. 행정소송 및 행정심판 업무의 수행
rows.text_en: 1. Performance of administrative litigation and administrative appeal duties

rows.source_ko: 2. 행정소송 판례 및 행정심판 재결례의 분석 및 전파
rows.text_en: 2. Analysis and Dissemination of Administrative Litigation Precedents and Administrative Appeal Decisions

rows.source_ko: 3. 지방노동위원회의 행정소송 및 행정심판 업무 총괄 및 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the overall management and support of administrative litigation and administrative appeal affairs of the Regional Labor Relations Commission

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 행정소송 및 행정심판 업무의 통계관리 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters concerning the statistical management, etc. of administrative litigation and administrative appeal affairs

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 중앙노동위원회 위원장은 업무의 성격 및 업무량 등을 고려하여 교섭대표결정과장, 심판 1과장 및 심판 2과장의 분장사무를 조정할 수 있다. <신설 2015. 8. 24.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Chairperson of the Central Labor Relations Commission may adjust the assigned duties of the Head of the Decision on Bargaining Representatives Division, the Head of the First Adjudication Division, and the Head of the Second Adjudication Division, taking into consideration the nature and workload of the work. <Newly added Aug. 24, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제19조(지방노동위원회 위원장 및 상임위원) ① 지방노동위원회 위원장 및 상임위원은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보한다. <개정 2013. 12. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Chairperson and Standing Commissioners of the Regional Labor Relations Commission) ① The Chairperson and Standing Commissioners of the Regional Labor Relations Commission shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service. <Amended Dec. 11, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 서울지방노동위원회 위원장의 직무등급은 가등급으로 하고, 서울지방노동위원회 상임위원, 그 밖의 지방노동위원회의 위원장 및 상임위원의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The job grade of the Chairperson of the Seoul Regional Labor Relations Commission shall be Grade A, and the job grade of the Standing Commissioners of the Seoul Regional Labor Relations Commission and the Chairpersons and Standing Commissioners of other Regional Labor Relations Commissions shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 제19조의2(지방노동위원회 사무국장) 서울지방노동위원회 사무국장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 그 밖의 지방노동위원회 사무국장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. 다만, 인천ㆍ울산ㆍ강원ㆍ충북 및 전북지방노동위원회의 사무국장은 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 2. 28., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 19-2 (Secretary General of Regional Labor Relations Commissions) The Secretary General of the Seoul Regional Labor Relations Commission shall be appointed as a Deputy Director General, a Science and Technology Secretary, or a Secretary, and the Secretary Generals of other Regional Labor Relations Commissions shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary or a Secretary. Provided, however, that the Secretary Generals of the Incheon, Ulsan, Gangwon, Chungbuk, and Jeonbuk Regional Labor Relations Commissions shall be appointed as Administrative Officers. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Feb. 28, 2017; Aug. 30, 2023>
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 17, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제20조(지방노동위원회사무국에 두는 과) ① 서울지방노동위원회 사무국에 조정과ㆍ교섭대표결정과ㆍ심판 1과ㆍ심판 2과 및 심판 3과를 두되, 각 과장은 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2008. 8. 11., 2011. 3. 2., 2020. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Divisions in the Secretariat of the Regional Labor Relations Commission) ① The Secretariat of the Seoul Regional Labor Relations Commission shall have the Mediation Division, the Determination of Bargaining Representative Division, the Adjudication Division 1, the Adjudication Division 2, and the Adjudication Division 3; provided that the heads of each division shall be appointed as Administrative Officers. <Amended Aug. 11, 2008; Mar. 2, 2011; Jun. 30, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 부산ㆍ경기ㆍ충남ㆍ전남ㆍ경북 및 경남지방노동위원회 사무국에 조정과 및 심판과(경기지방노동위원회 사무국에는 심판 1과, 심판 2과를 둔다)를 두되, 각 과장은 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2011. 3. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Mediation Divisions and Adjudication Divisions shall be established in the secretariats of the Busan, Gyeonggi, Chungnam, Jeonnam, Gyeongbuk, and Gyeongnam Regional Labor Relations Commissions (the secretariat of the Gyeonggi Regional Labor Relations Commission shall have Adjudication Division 1 and Adjudication Division 2), and the heads of each division shall be appointed as Administrative Officers. <Amended Mar. 2, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③ 조정과장은 제18조 제4항제1호ㆍ제2호ㆍ제4호ㆍ제4호의2ㆍ제4호의3ㆍ제5호(교원노동관계조정위원회 및 공무원노동관계조정위원회에 관한 사항은 제외한다)의 사항과 다음 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2011. 3. 2., 2021. 4. 13.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of the Coordination Division shall be responsible for the matters under Article 18 , Paragraph 4, Subparagraphs 1, 2, 4, 4-2, 4-3, and 5 (excluding matters concerning the Committee on Labor Relations for Teachers and the Committee on Labor Relations for Public Officials) and the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 2, 2011; Apr. 13, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 보안 및 관인관리
rows.text_en: 1. Security and Official Seal Management

rows.source_ko: 2. 기록물의 접수ㆍ발송ㆍ심사ㆍ발간 및 보존
rows.text_en: 2. Receipt, dispatch, examination, publication, and preservation of records

rows.source_ko: ④ 교섭대표결정과장(서울지방노동위원회 사무국에만 해당한다)은 제5항제1호부터 제6호까지의 사항 및 제18조제5항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2011. 3. 2., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 8. 24.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Determination of Negotiation Representatives Division (applicable only to the Secretariat of the Seoul Regional Labor Relations Commission) shall be responsible for the matters under Paragraph 5, Subparagraphs 1 through 6, and the matters under each subparagraph of Article 18, Paragraph 5. <Newly added Mar. 2, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013; Aug. 24, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 심판과장(서울지방노동위원회의 경우 심판 1과장ㆍ심판 2과장 및 심판 3과장, 경기지방노동위원회의 경우 심판 1과장 및 심판 2과장을 말한다)은 제18조제5항 각 호의 사항, 제18조제6항 각 호, 제18조제7항제1호, 제2호 및 제4호의 사항과 다음 각 호의 사항을 분장한다. 다만, 서울지방노동위원회 심판 1과장ㆍ심판 2과장 및 심판3과장의 경우 제1호부터 제6호까지의 사항 및 제18조제5항 각 호의 사항은 제외한다. <개정 2011. 3. 2., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 8. 24., 2020. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Adjudication Division (referring to the Heads of Adjudication Divisions 1, 2, and 3 in the case of the Seoul Regional Labor Relations Commission, and the Heads of Adjudication Divisions 1 and 2 in the case of the Gyeonggi Regional Labor Relations Commission) shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 18 , Paragraph 5 ; each subparagraph of Article 18 , Paragraph 6 ; and subparagraphs 1 , 2 , and 4 of Article 18, Paragraph 7 ; and the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. However, in the case of the Heads of Adjudication Divisions 1, 2, and 3 of the Seoul Regional Labor Relations Commission, the matters under subparagraphs 1 through 6 and the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 18 , Paragraph 5 shall be excluded. <Amended Mar. 2, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013; Aug. 24, 2015; Jun. 30, 2020>
